metrics.name: hook_rate
metrics.plain: how many people stop scrolling in the first 3 seconds of a video ad
metrics.formula: 3-second video plays divided by impressions
metrics.source: Meta ad-day and video-day rows (existing gallery cache)
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days with no new spend
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 500 impressions, or the ad is mostly shown as a still image (video played in under 20% of impressions)
metrics.benchmark: industry range about 15 to 25% for cold prospecting video on Meta feed; varies by category, account-relative is more reliable

metrics.name: hold_rate
metrics.plain: of the people who stopped, how many kept watching
metrics.formula: ThruPlays divided by 3-second plays
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days with no new spend
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 500 impressions or mostly shown as a still image
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only, no external benchmark

metrics.name: audience_reach_growth
metrics.plain: whether the ad set still has new people to show the ad to
metrics.formula: reach in the last 7 days divided by reach in the 7 days before it, minus 1
metrics.source: Meta ad-set reach and frequency rows
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 3 days with no new spend
metrics.unavailable_when: ad set has no reach breakdown in the pull
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; used to separate a shrinking pool from real creative wear

metrics.name: days_to_fatigue_by_format
metrics.plain: how many days a format usually lasts before it starts losing steam
metrics.formula: median days from first spend to the day CTR first drops 25% and stays down, grouped by format
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 ads of that format have a full lifecycle
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only

metrics.name: winner_breakdown_coverage
metrics.plain: share of this month's clear winners and losers that actually have a written reason on file
metrics.formula: ads in the top or bottom spend quartile with a saved breakdown, divided by all ads in that quartile
metrics.source: breakdowns.json (existing) plus spend quartile from the gallery
metrics.unavailable_when: no breakdowns saved yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

metrics.name: brief_to_launch_days
metrics.plain: how long it takes from a written brief to the ad actually spending
metrics.formula: median of (first spend date minus brief date) for ads matched to a brief_id
metrics.source: new brief log matched to ad launch date
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 3 briefs matched to a launched ad
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only

metrics.name: concepts_per_brief
metrics.plain: how many usable variants one brief produces in the studio
metrics.formula: count of saved studio variants divided by count of briefs in the same period
metrics.unavailable_when: no briefs logged this period
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only

metrics.name: new_ad_hit_rate
metrics.plain: share of newly launched ads that actually earn a Scale verdict
metrics.formula: ads launched in the window that reach a Scale verdict within 14 days of first spend, divided by all ads launched in the window
metrics.source: existing verdict engine plus launch date
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 ads launched in the window
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; compare this month to the trailing quarter

metrics.name: cost_per_produced_asset
metrics.plain: what a finished asset actually costs, all in
metrics.formula: sum of AI credits, freelancer or agency invoices and stock license fees for the month, divided by finished assets that reached a live ad that month
metrics.unavailable_when: no cost entries logged this month
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only, compared to the trailing 3-month average

metrics.name: pipeline_volume_vs_plan
metrics.plain: are we on pace to make as much creative as the plan calls for
metrics.formula: assets shipped to a live ad this month divided by the month's planned asset count
metrics.unavailable_when: no plan set for the month
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100% by month end

metrics.name: dpa_feed_health
metrics.plain: share of catalogue products whose price and badge overlay actually render correctly
metrics.formula: SKUs with no flagged overlay issue divided by all active SKUs in the feed
metrics.source: catalogue feed plus overlay QA log
metrics.unavailable_when: no DPA or catalogue-retargeting campaign running
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

metrics.name: rights_expiry_risk
metrics.plain: how many live ads are about to lose their license or authorization
metrics.formula: count of live ads whose stock, music, font license or creator whitelisting record expires within 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: no rights log entries exist
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 0

metrics.name: resize_and_caption_coverage
metrics.plain: share of approved masters that have every required size, caption and alt text ready
metrics.formula: approved masters with all required placement specs generated, captioned and alt-texted, divided by all approved masters
metrics.source: new asset export and QA log
metrics.unavailable_when: no export log yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100% within 3 days of approval

metrics.name: predictive_score_agreement
metrics.plain: whether the pre-spend score actually predicted the real result
metrics.formula: scored ads whose predicted bucket (strong, mixed, weak) matches their actual 14-day verdict bucket, divided by all scored ads with 14 days of spend
metrics.source: predictive scoring log plus verdict engine
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 10 scored ads have 14 days of spend
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; below 50% means treat the score as a rough filter only

metrics.name: competitor_format_angle_gap_count
metrics.plain: how many formats or angles competitors run at volume that we have not tested recently
metrics.formula: count of format-or-angle combinations run by 3 or more competitors on over 20% of their active ads, with zero matching live ads from this account in the trailing 90 days
metrics.source: competitor snapshot (competitors.json, comp_media.json) plus own tag taxonomy (themes.py)
metrics.window: latest competitor pull vs trailing 90 days own
metrics.freshness_rule: stale when the competitor pull is over 30 days old
metrics.unavailable_when: no competitor pull on file
metrics.benchmark: signal only, not a proven winner

metrics.name: approved_draft_backlog
metrics.plain: how many approved creatives are waiting to become a real draft ad
metrics.formula: count of approved creatives with no matching Ads Manager draft ID after 3 business days
metrics.unavailable_when: no approval log yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 0 after 3 business days

metrics.name: production_cost_share_of_media_spend
metrics.plain: how much of the ad budget is going into making the ads versus running them
metrics.formula: monthly production cost divided by monthly media spend
metrics.source: production cost log and Meta spend total
metrics.unavailable_when: no cost entries logged this month
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only

insights.name: worn_out_vs_undertested
insights.rule: an ad's CTR is down 25% or more and ROAS is down 30% or more over the last 7 days versus the prior 21, AND its ad set's reach in the last 7 days grew less than 10% versus the 7 days before: call it worn out. If reach still grew 10% or more while CTR or ROAS fell, call it a targeting or sequencing problem, not fatigue.
insights.sentence: {ad_name} looks worn out. CTR is down {ctr_pct}% and its audience has stopped growing.
insights.severity: high if ROAS is below target, otherwise medium

insights.name: hidden_gem_hook
insights.rule: an ad's hook_rate is in the top quartile of the account's trailing 90 days, but its verdict is Watch or Cut
insights.sentence: {ad_name}'s hook stops {hook_pct}% of viewers, above your best quarter of ads, but it is not converting. Try the same hook with a different offer.

insights.name: loser_with_no_breakdown
insights.rule: an ad in the bottom spend quartile has spent at least one target CPA, its ROAS is under half the target, and it has been live 14 days or more with no saved breakdown
insights.sentence: {ad_name} spent {spend} at {roas}x with no breakdown on file. Write one before the next batch is commissioned.

insights.name: brief_less_spend
insights.rule: an ad is currently spending and has no brief_id recorded in the brief log
insights.sentence: {n} live ads have no brief on file, including {ad_name}.

insights.name: pipeline_behind_plan
insights.rule: assets shipped this month are under 70% of the planned count with 5 or fewer days left in the month
insights.sentence: {shipped} of {planned} planned assets have shipped with {days} days left this month.

insights.name: cost_per_asset_drifting_up
insights.rule: this month's cost per produced asset is more than 1.3 times the trailing 3-month average
insights.sentence: Cost per finished asset is {cost}, {pct}% above your 3-month average.

insights.name: rights_expiring_soon
insights.rule: a live ad's stock, music, font license or creator whitelisting record expires within 14 days
insights.sentence: {n} live ads use a license or authorization expiring within 14 days.

insights.name: dpa_template_broken
insights.rule: overlay QA flags an issue on more than 2% of active catalogue SKUs
insights.sentence: {pct}% of SKUs in the feed show a broken price or badge overlay.

insights.name: asset_qa_gap
insights.rule: an approved master creative is missing a required placement size, a burned-in caption, or alt text more than 3 days after approval
insights.sentence: {n} approved creatives are missing a size, caption or alt text more than 3 days after approval.

insights.name: predictive_score_miscalibrated
insights.rule: the predictive score's bucket matched the actual 14-day verdict on fewer than half of the last 20 scored ads
insights.sentence: The pre-spend score matched the real result on only {pct}% of the last {n} ads. Treat it as a rough filter, not a green light.

insights.name: competitor_volume_gap
insights.rule: 3 or more competitors run a format or angle on over 20% of their active ads, and this account has zero live ads in that format or angle in the trailing 90 days
insights.sentence: {n} competitors run {format_or_angle} on over a fifth of their active ads. You have none live in the last 90 days. This is a signal, not proof it will work here.

insights.name: draft_backlog_piling_up
insights.rule: an approved creative has waited more than 3 business days without a matching Ads Manager draft ID
insights.sentence: {n} approved creatives have waited over 3 days to become a draft ad.

insights.name: hit_rate_falling
insights.rule: the new-ad hit rate for launches in the last 30 days is 20 percentage points or more below the trailing 90-day hit rate, with at least 5 launches in each window
insights.sentence: Only {pct}% of last month's new ads hit Scale, versus {pct2}% over the last quarter.

not_elsewhere.claim: Root-causes fatigue as a worn-out audience versus an under-tested budget, by checking whether the ad set's own reach has actually stopped growing
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager's native fatigue flag reports rising frequency and falling CTR only; it does not check whether reach growth has actually flattened for that ad set

not_elsewhere.claim: Ties a written why-it-worked or why-it-failed hypothesis to this account's own numbers and its brief, for every winner and loser
not_elsewhere.vs: Foreplay and Motion tag ad elements like hook, format and angle automatically, but neither writes a hypothesis for this account's own result or links it back to the brief that produced it

not_elsewhere.claim: Tracks real production cost per finished asset against the month's budget line and plan
not_elsewhere.vs: Triple Whale's Creative Cockpit reports ROAS, thumbstop rate and hold rate per creative, but has no cost-per-asset or pipeline-budget view

not_elsewhere.claim: Flags stock, music, font and creator-whitelisting rights expiring on currently live ads before a takedown risk lands
not_elsewhere.vs: no creative analytics tool in this category tracks license or authorization expiry against ads that are actually live right now

not_elsewhere.claim: Closes the loop on the pre-spend predictive score by checking it against this account's own real 14-day verdict
not_elsewhere.vs: predictive creative scoring tools report a score at upload time but do not check it later against what the ad actually did in this account

not_elsewhere.claim: Flags a broken price or badge overlay at the SKU level on the rendered creative itself, before a DPA campaign goes live at scale
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta's Catalog diagnostics flag missing or malformed feed fields, not whether the price or badge overlay actually renders correctly on the ad

founder_view_note: Before any brief, cost or rights log exists, the room shows only what the Meta gallery already tracks: ad-level winners, losers and the existing spend-based fatigue flag. The breakdown coverage, pipeline, cost and rights sections show 'not started, nothing logged yet' rather than 0 or blank. The first useful thing to appear, once a single brief is logged, is whether current spend is running against a written brief at all.

metrics.name: claim_check_pass_rate
metrics.plain: share of copy sets that clear the claim check the first time
metrics.formula: copy sets passed on first check divided by all copy sets checked
metrics.unavailable_when: no checks logged yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100% before anything ships

metrics.name: flagged_claims_open
metrics.plain: how many live ads or pages currently carry an unresolved flagged claim
metrics.formula: count of live assets with a claim-check status of flag and no resolution
metrics.source: claim check log joined to live ad and page set
metrics.unavailable_when: no claim tiers defined for this brand yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 0

metrics.name: message_match_score
metrics.plain: how much of the ad's promise the landing page still says
metrics.formula: matched items (same headline claim, same price or offer, same guarantee line, same top benefit) divided by total items checked, times 100
metrics.source: ad copy inventory plus captured page copy blocks
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days or after any page edit
metrics.unavailable_when: page copy blocks not yet captured for that destination
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100% on offer and price terms

metrics.name: drift_alerts_count
metrics.plain: how many live ads no longer match the page they send to
metrics.formula: count of live ads flagged for an image, price, offer or headline mismatch against the current page
metrics.unavailable_when: page copy blocks not captured
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 0

metrics.name: reading_grade_level
metrics.plain: how hard the last month of shipped copy is to read
metrics.formula: median Flesch-Kincaid grade level of copy shipped in the window
metrics.unavailable_when: no drafts QA'd yet
metrics.benchmark: brand rule: at or below grade 10

metrics.name: voice_compliance_rate
metrics.plain: share of drafts that pass the account's own writing rules with no fixes needed
metrics.formula: drafts with zero em dashes, zero banned words and reading grade at or below 10, divided by all drafts QA'd
metrics.unavailable_when: no drafts QA'd yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

metrics.name: em_dash_and_banned_word_catches
metrics.plain: how many rule breaks the QA step is catching before ship
metrics.formula: count of em dash or banned-word hits caught in QA before a draft shipped
metrics.unavailable_when: no drafts QA'd yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; a leading indicator, not a failure count

metrics.name: objection_coverage
metrics.plain: share of the top real objections that actually have a live line answering them
metrics.formula: top 10 objections by frequency with at least one live tagged ad or page line, divided by 10
metrics.source: objection log plus copy inventory tagged by objection
metrics.window: objection ranking on trailing 90 days, coverage checked current
metrics.unavailable_when: no objection log built yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100% on the top 5

metrics.name: offer_approval_lag
metrics.plain: how long an offer line waits for a founder decision
metrics.formula: median days between an offer copy draft and a recorded founder decision
metrics.unavailable_when: no offer decisions logged yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only

metrics.name: price_framing_consistency
metrics.plain: share of live prices using the framing rule the founder actually approved
metrics.formula: live price mentions matching the approved framing rule, divided by all live price mentions
metrics.source: copy scan of live assets for price patterns
metrics.unavailable_when: no approved framing rule on file
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

metrics.name: sms_email_rule_violations
metrics.plain: how many drafted sends broke a rule before they shipped
metrics.formula: count of drafted SMS or email sends missing the opt-out line, over the length limit, or breaking the cadence rule, caught before send
metrics.unavailable_when: no lifecycle drafts QA'd yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 0 that reach send

metrics.name: product_url_draft_turnaround
metrics.plain: how fast a product page turns into a first-pass ad copy set
metrics.formula: median minutes from product URL submitted to a delivered draft set
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 3 runs logged
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only

metrics.name: cod_touchpoint_coverage
metrics.plain: share of COD checkout and post-purchase moments that carry an approved trust or prepaid-nudge line
metrics.formula: touchpoints on the account's fixed list with an approved line attached, divided by all touchpoints on that list
metrics.unavailable_when: no fixed touchpoint list on file
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

metrics.name: marketplace_claim_alignment
metrics.plain: share of marketplace listing and A+ claims that match the same claim tier used in ads
metrics.formula: listing or module claims present in the approved claim tier set, divided by all claims found
metrics.source: marketplace copy log versus claim tier log
metrics.window: checked at each listing refresh, trailing 90 days
metrics.unavailable_when: no marketplace copy log yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

metrics.name: bulk_upload_sheet_error_rate
metrics.plain: share of rows in the last upload batch that would fail on submission
metrics.formula: rows failing a required field or character-limit check, divided by all rows in the batch
metrics.unavailable_when: no batch run yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 0 before submission

metrics.name: naming_taxonomy_compliance
metrics.plain: share of new copy assets tagged with the full fixed taxonomy at ship time
metrics.formula: assets shipped with all 7 tags present (concept, persona, angle, offer, format, stage, source), divided by all assets shipped
metrics.unavailable_when: no tagging log yet
metrics.benchmark: account-relative only; target is 100%

insights.name: claim_flagged_before_launch
insights.rule: a claim check on a copy set returns any line matching a banned or unverified claim pattern: an unproven superlative, a named competitor comparison, or a guarantee that does not match the brand's actual policy
insights.sentence: {n} lines in this set are flagged: {list}. None can ship until cleared.

insights.name: message_match_drift
insights.rule: a live ad's offer, price or headline term no longer appears in any of its landing destination's current copy blocks
insights.sentence: {ad_name} promises {term}, but the page it sends to no longer says it.

insights.name: reading_level_creeping_up
insights.rule: the median reading grade level of shipped copy over the trailing 30 days is above grade 10
insights.sentence: The last 30 days of copy reads at grade {grade}, above the grade-10 limit.

insights.name: top_objection_has_no_line
insights.rule: an objection ranked in the top 5 by frequency in the trailing 90 days has zero live ad or page line tagged to it
insights.sentence: {objection} is the number {rank} reason buyers hesitate, and no live line answers it.

insights.name: offer_approval_stalled
insights.rule: an offer copy draft has waited more than 5 business days without a recorded founder decision
insights.sentence: {offer_name} has waited {days} days for a yes or no.

insights.name: price_framing_inconsistent
insights.rule: more than 20% of live price mentions do not match the account's approved framing rule
insights.sentence: {pct}% of live prices are not framed the way you approved.

insights.name: sms_email_violation_caught
insights.rule: a drafted SMS or email send is missing the opt-out line, exceeds the approved length, or breaks the account's cadence rule, caught before it ships
insights.sentence: {n} drafted sends this week broke a rule before they shipped: {list}.

insights.name: marketplace_claim_mismatch
insights.rule: a marketplace listing or A+ module claim is not present in the account's approved claim tier set used in ads
insights.sentence: {listing} claims {term}, which is not in your approved claim list.

insights.name: bulk_upload_will_fail
insights.rule: a prepped upload sheet has a row missing a required field or over a platform character limit, caught before submission
insights.sentence: {n} rows in this batch will fail on upload: {reason}.

insights.name: naming_taxonomy_gap
insights.rule: a shipped copy asset is missing one or more of the 7 fixed tags
insights.sentence: {n} assets shipped without full tagging this month.

insights.name: cod_trust_message_missing
insights.rule: a checkout or post-purchase touchpoint on the account's fixed list has no approved prepaid-nudge or RTO-trust line attached
insights.sentence: {touchpoint} has no prepaid or delivery-trust line.

insights.name: product_url_draft_slow
insights.rule: the last 5 product-URL-to-draft runs took more than twice the trailing 30-day median turnaround
insights.sentence: The last {n} product-page drafts took {minutes} minutes, {pct}% slower than usual.

insights.name: destination_routing_conflict
insights.rule: two or more live ads target the same keyword or audience but route to different destinations selling the same product
insights.sentence: {n} live ads route the same audience to different pages for the same product.

insights.name: voice_rule_catches_rising
insights.rule: more than 10% of drafts this week were caught with an em dash or a banned inflated word before shipping
insights.sentence: {pct}% of this week's drafts needed an em dash or banned-word fix before they shipped.

not_elsewhere.claim: Scores message match by checking the ad's actual offer, price and headline terms against this brand's own current page copy blocks
not_elsewhere.vs: Instapage's AdMap gives a generic match score between an ad and its landing page, but it is not tied to this brand's own claim tiers or copy-block structure, and the page needs to be built inside Instapage

not_elsewhere.claim: Ranks real customer objections from this account's own support tickets and reviews, then checks whether a live line actually answers each one
not_elsewhere.vs: no ad-copy tool ranks objections from a brand's own support data and checks copy coverage against that ranking

not_elsewhere.claim: Catches an SMS or email draft breaking the opt-out, length or the account's own cadence rule before it ships, not after

not_elsewhere.claim: Flags a marketplace listing claim that is not in the same approved claim tier used in this brand's ads
not_elsewhere.vs: Amazon's own listing quality tools check keyword and image compliance, not claim consistency with the brand's ad copy

not_elsewhere.claim: Tracks reading grade level and rule catches over time as a trend against this account's own writing rules
not_elsewhere.vs: Hemingway scores one paste at a time and keeps no per-account rule set or history

metrics.name: blended_mer
metrics.plain: Total new-customer revenue for every rupee of ad spend, across all channels
metrics.formula: total new customer revenue / total spend (Meta + TikTok + Google)
metrics.source: brand brain revenue ledger + ad platform spend
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without a new order pull
metrics.unavailable_when: brand brain revenue ledger not connected
metrics.benchmark: brand's own target, set from contribution margin (source: MEDIA-C08)

metrics.name: meta_platform_roas
metrics.plain: What Meta itself says it returned
metrics.formula: purchase value / spend, period totals only
metrics.unavailable_when: no reported purchase value in range
metrics.benchmark: brand's saved target ROAS

metrics.name: tiktok_platform_roas
metrics.plain: What TikTok itself says it returned
metrics.formula: attributed revenue / spend, period totals only
metrics.unavailable_when: TikTok account not connected or no spend in range
metrics.benchmark: brand's saved target ROAS

metrics.name: new_customer_cac
metrics.plain: What it costs to win one new customer
metrics.formula: total spend / new customers acquired
metrics.unavailable_when: new-vs-existing customer flag missing on orders
metrics.benchmark: gross profit on first order (GP-to-CAC target from MEDIA-C08)

metrics.name: frequency_by_segment_30d
metrics.plain: How many times the same person saw an ad in 30 days, by audience, not blended
metrics.formula: impressions / reach per audience segment, 30-day window
metrics.unavailable_when: segment has under 1,000 reach
metrics.benchmark: rising frequency with flat cold reach flags fatigue

metrics.name: spend_pace_vs_budget
metrics.plain: Are we on track to land on this month's budget
metrics.formula: (spend to date / days elapsed) x days in month, vs planned monthly budget
metrics.source: ad platform daily spend + brand's stated monthly budget
metrics.unavailable_when: monthly budget not set by founder
metrics.benchmark: within 10% of plan

metrics.name: month_end_mer_forecast
metrics.plain: Where blended MER is heading if nothing changes
metrics.formula: trailing 7-day MER projected across remaining days, weighted by trailing pace
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 7 days of MER history
metrics.benchmark: brand's monthly MER floor

metrics.name: adset_verdict
metrics.plain: Keep, watch or kill, read at the ad set level
metrics.formula: ROAS vs target read at 3x to 5x target CPA spent (rule set in MEDIA-C17)
metrics.source: ad platform ad set metrics + brand's target CPA
metrics.unavailable_when: ad set has spent under 1x target CPA (not enough data)
metrics.benchmark: n/a, this is the rule itself

metrics.name: creative_volume_ratio
metrics.plain: New ads launched against the $1,000-of-spend benchmark
metrics.formula: new ads launched in period / (monthly spend / 1000)
metrics.unavailable_when: spend under $1,000 in period
metrics.benchmark: about 1 new ad per $1,000 monthly spend (MEDIA-C16)

metrics.name: concept_count_vs_band
metrics.plain: Number of live concepts against the band for this spend tier
metrics.formula: count of distinct SKU + pain-point + offer concepts currently live
metrics.unavailable_when: naming convention not followed (cannot parse concepts)
metrics.benchmark: spend-tier band from MEDIA-C09

metrics.name: existing_customer_spend_share
metrics.plain: Share of spend protecting existing customers vs winning new ones
metrics.formula: spend in the dedicated existing-customer campaign / total spend
metrics.source: campaign-level spend, tagged by campaign purpose
metrics.unavailable_when: no campaign tagged as existing-customer
metrics.benchmark: cold spend share should be growing period over period

metrics.name: dpa_7day_click_roas
metrics.plain: Dynamic product ad return, read the way it should be read
metrics.formula: attributed value on 7-day click window / DPA ad set spend
metrics.source: Meta ad account, DPA ad sets only
metrics.unavailable_when: no DPA ad set running
metrics.benchmark: never compared to blended platform ROAS

metrics.name: pixel_capi_match_quality
metrics.plain: How well orders and their value are passing through to Meta
metrics.formula: event match quality score + share of purchase events with value populated
metrics.unavailable_when: events manager read not available
metrics.benchmark: above 6.0 match quality, 100% of purchases carry value

metrics.name: suggestion_log_status
metrics.plain: How many platform suggestions were applied without a logged test
metrics.formula: count of applied Advantage+/automated suggestions with no before/after entry
metrics.source: suggestion log (brand record) + platform change history
metrics.unavailable_when: no suggestion log kept yet
metrics.benchmark: 0 unlogged suggestions

metrics.name: tiktok_spark_authorization_days_left
metrics.plain: Days left on a creator's Spark authorization
metrics.formula: 365 - days since authorization code granted, per active Sparked post
metrics.unavailable_when: no Spark authorization on file for an active post
metrics.benchmark: renew before 0 days left

metrics.name: account_quality_flags
metrics.plain: Open policy rejections or account-quality warnings across Meta and TikTok
metrics.formula: count of open disapprovals / quality flags
metrics.source: Meta and TikTok account activity logs
metrics.unavailable_when: activity log read not available
metrics.benchmark: 0 open flags

metrics.name: message_match_lag_days
metrics.plain: Days since the best-performing ad's headline last matched the landing page
metrics.formula: days since landing page headline was updated to mirror the current top ad's headline
metrics.source: ad creative text + landing page snapshot
metrics.unavailable_when: landing page not connected for snapshotting
metrics.benchmark: under 1 day (MEDIA-C44)

metrics.name: stock_pace_risk
metrics.plain: Whether a scaling ad set is about to sell out its product
metrics.formula: days of stock left at current sales pace, for products in ad sets tagged Scale
metrics.source: brand's stock feed + ad set product tags
metrics.unavailable_when: stock feed not connected
metrics.benchmark: flag under 14 days of stock left

metrics.name: competitor_discount_overlap
metrics.plain: Shared products a competitor is discounting 20% or more
metrics.formula: count of the brand's ad-featured products also seen discounted 20-30%+ in competitor ad library snapshot
metrics.source: competitor ad library data + brand product ad tags
metrics.unavailable_when: no competitor snapshot taken
metrics.benchmark: n/a, informational flag

metrics.name: marginal_roas_by_channel
metrics.plain: What the next rupee of spend would likely return, by channel
metrics.formula: change in value / change in spend over the last 2 comparable budget steps, per channel
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 budget steps to compare
metrics.benchmark: used only for founder-gate allocation calls (MEDIA-C58)

insights.name: MER disagrees with platform ROAS
insights.rule: blended MER is 20% or more below Meta or TikTok's own reported ROAS for the same period
insights.sentence: Meta says {platform_roas}x but the brand's own numbers say {blended_mer}x. Check attribution before scaling.

insights.name: kill/keep/scale table
insights.rule: at 3x to 5x target CPA spent with ROAS more than 30% below target and no purchases, mark Kill; within 30% of target, mark Watch; at or above target, mark Scale
insights.sentence: {n} ad sets are ready to kill, {n} to scale.

insights.name: frequency rising, reach flat
insights.rule: 30-day frequency for a segment up 20% or more while cold reach for that segment is flat or falling
insights.sentence: {segment} frequency hit {freq}x with reach flat. Creative is wearing out, not the audience.
insights.severity: medium, rises with spend at risk

insights.name: spend or ROAS anomaly
insights.rule: a day's spend or ROAS moved 50% or more against the trailing 14-day median
insights.sentence: {date} spend moved {pct}% against the last 14 days. {ad_names} caused most of it.
insights.severity: high on the day it happens

insights.name: anomaly root cause fan-out
insights.rule: when an anomaly fires, pull same-day site speed, stock level and competitor activity automatically
insights.sentence: The {date} drop lines up with {cause} on the same day.
insights.severity: attached to the anomaly it explains

insights.name: creative volume below benchmark
insights.rule: new ads launched in 30 days is under 70% of (monthly spend / 1000)
insights.sentence: Only {n} new ads launched this month against a benchmark of {target}.

insights.name: DPA in the wrong bucket
insights.rule: a dynamic product ad set is inside the main cold CBO instead of its own capped ad set
insights.sentence: DPA is sharing budget with cold prospecting. Give it its own capped ad set.

insights.name: naming or purpose gap
insights.rule: a live campaign has no one-line purpose on file or its ad sets do not follow the fixed naming pattern
insights.sentence: {n} campaigns have no purpose line on file.

insights.name: scaling into a stockout
insights.rule: an ad set marked Scale features a product with under 14 days of stock left
insights.sentence: {ad_set} is scaling {product}, which has {days} days of stock left.

insights.name: competitor discount on a shared product
insights.rule: a competitor is discounting a product the brand also runs ads for by 20% or more
insights.sentence: {competitor} cut {product} by {pct}%. Consider pulling or de-prioritising it.

insights.name: message mismatch
insights.rule: the current top ad's headline has not appeared on the landing page within 1 day of becoming the top ad
insights.sentence: The top ad says '{headline}' but the landing page still says something else, {days} days on.

insights.name: unlogged platform suggestion
insights.rule: a platform-applied Advantage+ or automated suggestion has no before/after entry in the suggestion log
insights.sentence: {n} suggestions were applied with no test on record.

insights.name: Spark authorization expiring
insights.rule: an active Sparked post's creator authorization has 30 days or fewer left
insights.sentence: {creator}'s Spark authorization expires in {days} days.
insights.severity: high, ad stops delivering if it lapses

insights.name: policy rejection pattern
insights.rule: 2 or more rejections in 30 days cite the same policy clause
insights.sentence: {n} ads were rejected for {clause} this month. Fix the pattern, not just the ad.

insights.name: founder-gate queue non-empty
insights.rule: any decision the idea bank or catalogue marks founder_gate is open and unresolved
insights.sentence: {n} decisions are waiting on you: {labels}.

visuals.shows: month-to-date spend vs planned budget, with a projected end-of-month line

visuals.name: frequency by segment small multiples

visuals.name: anomaly strip

visuals.name: change log timeline

not_elsewhere.claim: puts ad-set kill/keep/scale verdicts next to same-day stock level and competitor discount data, not performance numbers alone
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager and rule tools like Revealbot judge only spend, ROAS and frequency inside the ad account; they do not see stock or competitor moves

not_elsewhere.claim: computes blended MER from the brand's own contribution margin and reconciles it against Meta's and TikTok's own reported ROAS every time before a scale call
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager report only their own platform ROAS; also in Triple Whale for a blended revenue number, but Triple Whale's number is not tied back to the brand's own margin ledger

not_elsewhere.claim: logs every Advantage+ or automated suggestion applied, with a persisted before/after read attached to it
not_elsewhere.vs: Ads Manager shows a suggestion feed but keeps no lasting before/after test log once a suggestion is applied

not_elsewhere.claim: fans one spend or ROAS anomaly out to the brand's own site speed, stock level and competitor snapshot from the same day, automatically
not_elsewhere.vs: Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager flag the anomaly inside the ad account but never look outside it for the cause

not_elsewhere.claim: tracks each TikTok Spark creator's 365-day authorization next to the organic post that earned it, with the expiry clock visible
not_elsewhere.vs: TikTok Ads Manager shows Spark ads live but not the organic-to-paid loop timing or authorization expiry in one place

not_elsewhere.claim: routes every founder-gate call (scale ceiling, WhatsApp COD rollout, new-surface pilot, agentic-bidding guardrail) into one queue instead of leaving it split across ad account settings
not_elsewhere.vs: no platform separates its own automation's suggestions from the calls only the founder should make

metrics.name: conversion_tracking_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of purchases where Google gets the real order value
metrics.formula: purchases with enhanced conversion value populated / total tracked purchases
metrics.unavailable_when: Google Ads read access not connected

metrics.name: merchant_center_health
metrics.plain: Whether Merchant Center is approved and add-ons are on
metrics.formula: count of open disapprovals + count of the 4 add-ons not enrolled
metrics.unavailable_when: Merchant Center not connected
metrics.benchmark: 0 disapprovals, 4 of 4 add-ons enrolled

metrics.name: feed_title_quality
metrics.plain: Share of titles that lead with the actual converting search term
metrics.formula: titles starting with a top-20 converting search term / total live titles
metrics.unavailable_when: search terms report has under 20 terms with conversions
metrics.benchmark: rising toward 100% in batches

metrics.name: brand_nonbrand_split
metrics.plain: Spend and ROAS split between brand and non-brand
metrics.formula: spend and value summed separately for campaigns tagged brand vs non-brand
metrics.unavailable_when: campaigns not tagged brand/non-brand
metrics.benchmark: brand excluded from every cold campaign by negative list and exclusion

metrics.name: nonbrand_cpa_vs_breakeven
metrics.plain: Is non-brand Search costing more than it can afford to
metrics.formula: non-brand CPA / break-even CPA (from margin)
metrics.source: Google Ads metrics + brand margin data
metrics.unavailable_when: break-even CPA not set
metrics.benchmark: at or under 1.0

metrics.name: pmax_control_flags
metrics.plain: How many control-hiding defaults are still switched on in PMax
metrics.formula: count of: URL expansion on, auto assets on, final URL expansion on, across active PMax campaigns
metrics.unavailable_when: no PMax campaign running

metrics.name: pmax_search_terms_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of PMax spend with a visible search term behind it
metrics.formula: spend on search terms shown in the PMax insights report / total PMax search spend
metrics.unavailable_when: PMax insights report not available for the account
metrics.benchmark: as high as Google will show; flag when this falls, not a fixed target

metrics.name: search_term_waste
metrics.plain: Spend on search terms with no conversions over the waste threshold
metrics.formula: sum of spend on terms with 0 conversions and spend over 2x average CPA
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 days of search term data
metrics.benchmark: trending down after negatives are added

metrics.name: bid_strategy_stage
metrics.plain: Where the account sits on the bidding ladder
metrics.formula: current strategy (Maximize Conversion Value, or Target ROAS with X% of conversions from that strategy)
metrics.source: Google Ads bid strategy settings + conversion volume
metrics.unavailable_when: n/a
metrics.benchmark: move to Target ROAS only once volume supports it (MEDIA-C39)

metrics.name: remarketing_list_size
metrics.plain: How big each remarketing list actually is
metrics.formula: member count per list
metrics.unavailable_when: audience manager not connected
metrics.benchmark: above the platform's minimum size to serve

metrics.name: cart_abandoner_list_size
metrics.plain: Size of the add-to-cart-minus-purchase list
metrics.formula: add-to-cart audience minus purchaser audience, member count
metrics.unavailable_when: add-to-cart tag not firing
metrics.benchmark: above minimum size to serve

metrics.name: budget_vs_sizing_formula
metrics.plain: Is today's budget in the recommended range for our stage
metrics.formula: daily budget / (3 to 4x AOV for Search and Shopping, or $50-100 and 3x non-brand CPA for PMax)
metrics.source: Google Ads budget settings + brand AOV
metrics.unavailable_when: AOV not set
metrics.benchmark: within the formula's range

metrics.name: scaling_gates_passed
metrics.plain: How many of the 5 scaling gates the account currently passes
metrics.formula: count of gates passed out of 5 (fixed gate list from MEDIA-C41)
metrics.unavailable_when: n/a
metrics.benchmark: 5 of 5 before adding budget or a new campaign type

metrics.name: youtube_demand_gen_readiness
metrics.plain: Whether Search and Shopping are dialled in enough to add video
metrics.formula: checklist score: Search/Shopping hitting target ROAS + proven Meta creative available + AOV fits video funnel
metrics.source: computed from campaign metrics + creative library
metrics.unavailable_when: Search/Shopping have not run 30 days at target
metrics.benchmark: all 3 checklist items true

metrics.name: google_blended_mer_gap
metrics.plain: Gap between Google's own ROAS and the brand's blended MER
metrics.formula: Google-reported ROAS minus blended MER, as a percentage of Google's ROAS
metrics.source: Google Ads metrics + brand revenue ledger
metrics.unavailable_when: brand revenue ledger not connected
metrics.benchmark: under 20% gap

metrics.name: disapproval_resolution_days
metrics.plain: How long a disapproved ad or product stays down
metrics.formula: days between disapproval flagged and resolved
metrics.unavailable_when: no disapprovals in range
metrics.benchmark: under 2 days

metrics.name: spend_pace_vs_budget_google
metrics.plain: Month-to-date spend against plan, Google only
metrics.formula: (spend to date / days elapsed) x days in month vs planned monthly budget
metrics.unavailable_when: monthly budget not set
metrics.benchmark: within 10% of plan

metrics.name: new_customer_cac_google
metrics.plain: Cost to win one new customer through Google
metrics.formula: Google spend / new customers attributed to Google
metrics.unavailable_when: new-customer tagging missing
metrics.benchmark: GP-to-CAC target from MEDIA-C08

metrics.name: addon_enrollment_status
metrics.plain: Which of the 4 Merchant Center add-ons are live
metrics.formula: count enrolled out of 4
metrics.unavailable_when: Merchant Center not connected
metrics.benchmark: 4 of 4

metrics.name: campaign_purpose_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of live campaigns with a written one-line purpose
metrics.formula: campaigns with a purpose note on file / total live campaigns
metrics.source: brand record + Google Ads campaign list
metrics.unavailable_when: no purpose notes kept yet

insights.name: title missing the converting term
insights.rule: a live product title does not start with a top-20 converting search term for that product type
insights.sentence: {n} titles do not lead with the term that actually converts.
insights.severity: medium, fixes over weeks not days

insights.name: PMax hiding control
insights.rule: URL expansion, auto assets or final URL expansion is still on for an active PMax campaign
insights.sentence: {campaign} still has {setting} on. Turn it off to see and control what runs.

insights.name: brand not excluded from cold
insights.rule: a non-brand or PMax campaign has no brand negative list or exclusion applied
insights.sentence: {campaign} has no brand exclusion. Brand searches may be inflating its ROAS.

insights.name: search term wasting spend
insights.rule: a search term has spent over 2x average CPA with 0 conversions in 30 days
insights.sentence: '{term}' spent {amount} with 0 conversions. Add it as a negative.

insights.name: remarketing list too small
insights.rule: a remarketing or cart-abandoner list is below the platform's minimum serving size
insights.sentence: {list} has {n} members, below the size Google needs to serve it. Wait before launching.

insights.name: ready to progress bid strategy
insights.rule: conversion volume has held above the platform's Target ROAS threshold for 4 straight weeks on Maximize Conversion Value
insights.sentence: Volume has supported Target ROAS for 4 weeks. Consider moving up a stage.
insights.severity: low, an opportunity not a risk

insights.name: budget outside the sizing formula
insights.rule: daily budget falls outside the AOV or CPA-based sizing range for the campaign's stage
insights.sentence: {campaign}'s budget is {pct}% outside the recommended range for its stage.

insights.name: scaling gate failed
insights.rule: fewer than 5 of 5 scaling gates pass
insights.sentence: Only {n} of 5 scaling gates pass. Hold budget until the rest clear.

insights.name: Merchant Center disapproval spike
insights.rule: open disapprovals rose 25% or more week over week
insights.sentence: Disapprovals rose to {n} this week, up from {prev}.

insights.name: YouTube added too early
insights.rule: a YouTube or Demand Gen campaign is live while youtube_demand_gen_readiness has an unmet checklist item
insights.sentence: YouTube is spending before {unmet_item} is in place.

insights.name: conversion value gap
insights.rule: conversion_tracking_coverage is under 95%
insights.sentence: {pct}% of purchases are passing real order value. The rest look like $0 conversions to Google.

insights.name: Google vs blended MER gap
insights.rule: google_blended_mer_gap is 20% or more
insights.sentence: Google reports {google_roas}x but the brand's own numbers say {mer}x.

insights.name: non-brand above break-even
insights.rule: nonbrand_cpa_vs_breakeven is over 1.0
insights.sentence: Non-brand CPA is {pct}% over break-even. Cut before adding budget.

insights.name: campaign with no purpose on file
insights.rule: a live campaign has no one-line purpose note
insights.sentence: {campaign} has no written purpose. Reporting confusion usually starts here.

not_elsewhere.vs: the Google Ads recommendations page scores a generic optimization score, not the brand's own gate rules

not_elsewhere.claim: sizes budgets to the brand's own AOV and non-brand break-even CPA, not a generic recommended-budget number
not_elsewhere.vs: Google Ads' own budget suggestions are volume-based, not tied to the brand's margin

not_elsewhere.claim: flags every Performance Max default that hides control (URL expansion, auto assets, final URL expansion) in one view
not_elsewhere.vs: these settings live in separate tabs inside Google Ads with no single audit view; also in Optmyzr's PMax audit for the same checks, at a subscription cost

not_elsewhere.claim: reconciles Google's own reported ROAS against the brand's blended MER before any scale call, using the brand's own margin data
not_elsewhere.vs: Google Ads reports its own ROAS only and has no blended, cross-channel or margin-based view

not_elsewhere.claim: checks feed titles against the brand's own converting search terms, not a generic title-length or keyword-stuffing checklist
not_elsewhere.vs: Merchant Center diagnostics flag policy violations, not title-to-search-term match

not_elsewhere.claim: reads the PMax search terms report next to a bid-strategy-stage gate, so a brand does not move to Target ROAS before it has volume
not_elsewhere.vs: Google Ads shows the search terms report and the bid strategy recommendation in separate places with no combined readiness check

founder_view_note: Before Google Ads is connected, the room shows nothing but a clear 'not connected' state on every metric, since the direct Marketing API is not active yet (only Meta is read-only connected today). The first thing to show once it connects is conversion_tracking_coverage and the scaling gate checklist, since a tracking gap or a failed gate protects against the worst decision (scaling on fake data or before the account has earned it).

metrics.name: affiliate_pipeline
metrics.plain: How many applicants are waiting, approved or rejected
metrics.formula: count of applications by status (pending, approved, rejected)
metrics.unavailable_when: affiliate network not connected
metrics.benchmark: pending under 3 days old

metrics.name: active_partner_count
metrics.plain: How many affiliates and creators are actively earning
metrics.formula: count of partners with at least 1 sale in trailing 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: affiliate network not connected
metrics.benchmark: growing period over period

metrics.name: commission_owed_vs_paid
metrics.plain: Gap between what the network says is owed and what was actually paid
metrics.formula: network-reported commission owed minus verified paid amount
metrics.source: affiliate network payout report + brand payment record
metrics.unavailable_when: payout report not available
metrics.benchmark: 0 gap

metrics.name: fraud_flag_count
metrics.plain: Number of open suspected-fraud flags
metrics.formula: count of affiliates matching fast click-to-conversion, suspect ISP, brand-bidding or big-ticket-early-order patterns
metrics.unavailable_when: click-level data not available
metrics.benchmark: 0 unresolved

metrics.name: commission_rate_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of partners with a set commission tier on file
metrics.formula: partners with an assigned tier / total active partners
metrics.unavailable_when: tier record not kept

metrics.name: amazon_brief_status
metrics.plain: Where the Amazon ads brief stands
metrics.formula: status flag: drafted, sent, acknowledged, live (manually updated)
metrics.source: brand record (Amazon Ads console not connected)
metrics.unavailable_when: no brief created yet
metrics.benchmark: n/a, status only

metrics.name: amazon_acos_reported
metrics.plain: Amazon's own ACOS, as last reported to us
metrics.formula: ad spend / ad-attributed sales, taken from whoever runs the account
metrics.source: manually entered from Amazon Ads console (not connected)
metrics.unavailable_when: no connector to Amazon Ads exists
metrics.benchmark: brand's target ACOS

metrics.name: flipkart_brief_status
metrics.plain: Where the Flipkart ads brief stands
metrics.formula: status flag: drafted, sent, acknowledged, live
metrics.unavailable_when: no brief created yet
metrics.benchmark: n/a, status only

metrics.name: quick_commerce_plan_status
metrics.plain: Where the Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart plan stands, per platform
metrics.formula: status flag per platform: drafted, sent, live
metrics.unavailable_when: no plan created yet
metrics.benchmark: n/a, status only

metrics.name: quick_commerce_roas_benchmark_gap
metrics.plain: How reported quick-commerce ROAS compares to the category benchmark
metrics.formula: reported ROAS (manually entered) minus benchmark (4-8x established SKUs, 1.5-3x new launches)
metrics.unavailable_when: no number reported yet
metrics.benchmark: see formula

metrics.name: retargeting_saturation_signal
metrics.plain: Whether Meta and Google retargeting pools are maxed out
metrics.formula: retargeting frequency at or above cap with flat reach, on both Meta and Google, for 14+ days
metrics.unavailable_when: Google not connected
metrics.benchmark: used only to trigger a DSP evaluation (MEDIA-C54)

metrics.name: invoice_vs_reported_variance
metrics.plain: Gap between a platform's invoice and its own reported spend
metrics.formula: invoiced amount minus platform-reported spend for the same period
metrics.source: platform invoices (Meta, Google, TikTok) + platform reporting
metrics.freshness_rule: stale once a new invoice lands unmatched
metrics.unavailable_when: invoice not yet received
metrics.benchmark: under 1% variance

metrics.name: invoice_vs_ledger_variance
metrics.plain: Gap between an invoice and the brand's own budget ledger
metrics.formula: invoiced amount minus ledger-recorded spend for the same period
metrics.unavailable_when: ledger entry missing for the period
metrics.benchmark: 0 variance

metrics.name: gst_rcm_reconciliation_status
metrics.plain: Whether GST and reverse-charge credits on ad invoices are reconciled
metrics.formula: count of invoices with GST/RCM matched to the credit ledger / total invoices
metrics.unavailable_when: accounting record not connected

metrics.name: billing_dispute_count
metrics.plain: Open disputes with a platform over billing
metrics.formula: count of open disputes
metrics.unavailable_when: no dispute tracker kept
metrics.benchmark: 0 open

metrics.name: organic_mentions_found
metrics.plain: Creators found organically using or reviewing the product
metrics.formula: count of public posts matching the brand or close competitor, found this scan
metrics.source: public social scan (brand's own or a close competitor's product)
metrics.unavailable_when: no scan run yet
metrics.benchmark: n/a, discovery count

metrics.name: whitelist_outreach_conversion
metrics.plain: Share of discovered creators who became paid partners
metrics.formula: creators who signed on / creators contacted
metrics.unavailable_when: no outreach record kept
metrics.benchmark: n/a, track for its own trend

metrics.name: affiliate_share_of_new_customers
metrics.plain: Share of new customers coming through the affiliate program
metrics.formula: new customers with an affiliate attribution / total new customers
metrics.unavailable_when: affiliate attribution not tagged on orders
metrics.benchmark: n/a, track for its own trend

metrics.name: coupon_abuse_rate
metrics.plain: Share of coupon redemptions that look abusive
metrics.formula: redemptions flagged (reused past limit, resold, or from a flagged affiliate) / total redemptions
metrics.unavailable_when: coupon system not connected
metrics.benchmark: under 2%

insights.name: fast click-to-conversion fraud pattern
insights.rule: a new affiliate's clicks convert in under the platform's normal minimum browse time, repeatedly
insights.sentence: {affiliate} converts clicks in under {seconds}s, {n} times this week. Check for cookie stuffing.

insights.name: big-ticket order right after signup
insights.rule: a new affiliate generates an order for a top-price-band item within 48 hours of joining
insights.sentence: {affiliate} placed a {amount} order {hours}h after joining. Hold this payout for review.

insights.name: unusual orders-to-clicks ratio
insights.rule: an affiliate's orders-to-clicks ratio is 3x or more the program average
insights.sentence: {affiliate}'s conversion rate is {x} the program average.

insights.name: commission mismatch
insights.rule: commission_owed_vs_paid variance exceeds 2% of the payout cycle total
insights.sentence: The network wants {amount} more than verified sales support. Reconcile before paying.

insights.name: brand-bidding affiliate
insights.rule: an affiliate is found bidding on the brand's own name in paid search
insights.sentence: {affiliate} is bidding on '{brand_term}' in search. This usually breaks program terms.

insights.name: invoice does not match platform report
insights.rule: invoice_vs_reported_variance exceeds 1%
insights.sentence: {platform}'s invoice is {pct}% off its own reported spend for {period}.

insights.name: invoice does not match ledger
insights.rule: invoice_vs_ledger_variance is non-zero
insights.sentence: {platform}'s invoice is {amount} off the budget ledger for {period}.

insights.name: GST credit unreconciled
insights.rule: an invoice's GST/RCM has not been matched to the accounting credit ledger
insights.sentence: {n} invoices have GST credits not yet matched.

insights.name: retargeting pool saturated
insights.rule: retargeting_saturation_signal is true on both Meta and Google
insights.sentence: Both Meta and Google retargeting are capped with flat reach. Worth a DSP pilot.
insights.severity: medium, an opportunity not a risk

insights.name: quick commerce underperforming benchmark
insights.rule: quick_commerce_roas_benchmark_gap is negative by more than 20%
insights.sentence: {platform} ROAS is {pct}% below the category benchmark.

insights.name: organic mention worth whitelisting
insights.rule: a discovered organic mention has engagement above the brand's set threshold and is not already a paid partner
insights.sentence: {creator} is already showing your product organically with {engagement} engagement. Reach out before offering payment.

insights.name: coupon abuse rising
insights.rule: coupon_abuse_rate rose 1 point or more week over week
insights.sentence: Coupon abuse rose to {pct}% this week.

metrics.name: revenue_by_flow_order_matched
metrics.plain: Revenue each flow actually produced, counted from real orders, not from a click window
metrics.formula: sum of order revenue where the order's contact received a flow send in the N days before the order (N set per flow type, default 5 days email / 3 days SMS-WhatsApp), attributed to the last flow send before the order
metrics.source: orders table joined to esp_sends log
metrics.unavailable_when: orders and esp_sends cannot be joined on the same contact id
metrics.benchmark: welcome flow typically 3 to 5 percent of total email/SMS revenue for a healthy list; no universal number, compare to this brand's own trend

metrics.name: flow_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of people who got a flow and then bought
metrics.formula: orders attributed to flow ÷ unique contacts who entered the flow, trailing window
metrics.unavailable_when: flow entry log missing for that flow
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, compare within brand across flow versions

metrics.name: deliverability_inbox_placement
metrics.plain: Share of sends that land in the inbox, not spam or missing
metrics.formula: 1 minus (bounce rate + spam complaint rate), proxy when no seed-test data exists
metrics.source: ESP bounce and complaint logs, seed-test tool if connected
metrics.unavailable_when: no bounce or complaint feed from the ESP
metrics.benchmark: under 0.1 percent complaint rate, under 2 percent bounce rate is healthy

metrics.name: list_health_score
metrics.plain: One number for whether the list is getting healthier or riskier to mail
metrics.formula: composite of bounce rate, spam complaint rate, and share of contacts with 0 opens in 180 days, each normalized 0 to 1 and averaged
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days without a refresh
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 4 weeks of send history
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch direction of travel

metrics.name: popup_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of visitors shown the pop-up who sign up
metrics.formula: pop-up sign-ups ÷ pop-up impressions
metrics.unavailable_when: pop-up tool does not log impressions
metrics.benchmark: 2 to 4 percent visitor-to-signup is a common range; treat as a comparison, not a target

metrics.name: time_to_first_purchase
metrics.plain: How long a new subscriber takes to buy for the first time
metrics.formula: median hours between signup timestamp and first order for subscribers who convert within 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: signup timestamp not captured
metrics.benchmark: shorter is better; compare against the brand's own last quarter

metrics.name: sms_whatsapp_opt_in_rate
metrics.plain: Share of email subscribers who also opt in to SMS or WhatsApp
metrics.formula: contacts with a valid SMS or WhatsApp consent record ÷ contacts with a valid email consent record
metrics.unavailable_when: consent_log missing a channel
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, track growth over time

metrics.name: consent_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of active contacts with a valid, current consent record for every channel they are sent on
metrics.formula: contacts with a logged, unexpired consent record for channel X ÷ contacts sent on channel X in the window
metrics.unavailable_when: no consent_log
metrics.benchmark: target 100 percent; any gap is a compliance risk, not a growth metric

metrics.name: list_growth_net
metrics.plain: New contacts minus people who leave the list
metrics.formula: new opted-in contacts − (unsubscribes + hard bounces + suppressions)
metrics.unavailable_when: consent_log has gaps in the period
metrics.benchmark: should stay positive; a negative month is a flag

metrics.name: unsubscribe_rate_per_send
metrics.plain: Share of people who unsubscribe from a single send
metrics.formula: unsubscribes ÷ delivered, per campaign or flow send
metrics.unavailable_when: send-level unsubscribe not logged
metrics.benchmark: under 0.2 percent per send is typical; above 0.5 percent needs a content check

metrics.name: whatsapp_cod_to_prepaid_conversion
metrics.plain: Share of WhatsApp cart-recovery or order-update messages that convert a COD order to prepaid
metrics.formula: orders switched from COD to prepaid after a WhatsApp nudge ÷ COD orders that received the nudge
metrics.unavailable_when: no WhatsApp events log or no COD flag on the order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target; India benchmark not public, track the brand's own baseline before and after the program

metrics.name: quiet_hours_violation_count
metrics.plain: Number of sends that went out outside the allowed local hours for that market
metrics.formula: count of esp_sends where sent_at local time falls outside the configured quiet-hours window for the contact's market
metrics.unavailable_when: contact market or local time zone unknown
metrics.benchmark: target zero

metrics.name: test_win_rate
metrics.plain: Share of tests in the queue that produced a real, pre-registered win
metrics.formula: tests marked won ÷ tests completed, where a win required hitting the pre-registered metric and sample size
metrics.unavailable_when: test_registry missing a result field
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch trend and hygiene violations

metrics.name: segment_freshness
metrics.plain: Days since a segment's definition was last recomputed against current data
metrics.formula: today minus last_computed_at, per segment
metrics.freshness_rule: flag stale after 7 days for RFM and buyer-stage segments
metrics.unavailable_when: segment has no last_computed_at
metrics.benchmark: under 7 days for behavior segments

metrics.name: welcome_flow_completion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of new subscribers who make it through the whole welcome sequence without unsubscribing
metrics.formula: contacts reaching final welcome step ÷ contacts entering step 1
metrics.unavailable_when: step-level flow log not available
metrics.benchmark: compare step to step, not to an outside number

metrics.name: winback_reactivation_rate
metrics.plain: Share of lapsed contacts in the win-back flow who place another order
metrics.formula: orders from win-back flow contacts ÷ contacts entering win-back
metrics.unavailable_when: flow entry not logged
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, track vs the brand's own prior version

metrics.name: flow_frequency_conflicts
metrics.plain: Number of contacts who got messages from 2 or more flows on the same day
metrics.formula: count of contact-days where esp_sends shows sends from more than one flow_id
metrics.unavailable_when: flow_id missing from send log
metrics.benchmark: target near zero, some overlap is unavoidable at high volume

metrics.name: channel_revenue_mix
metrics.plain: Share of lifecycle revenue coming from email vs SMS vs WhatsApp
metrics.formula: order-matched revenue per channel ÷ total order-matched lifecycle revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: channel field missing on a send
metrics.benchmark: no fixed split, watch for over-reliance on one channel

insights.name: flow revenue mismatch
insights.rule: the platform's reported flow revenue differs from order-matched flow revenue by more than 15 percent for a flow with at least 20 orders in the window
insights.sentence: {flow} shows {platform_rev} in your ESP but only {matched_rev} in real orders, a {pct} percent gap
insights.severity: high if gap over 30 percent, else medium

insights.name: quiet hours breach
insights.rule: quiet_hours_violation_count > 0 in the trailing 7 days
insights.sentence: {n} messages went out outside allowed hours in {market} this week

insights.name: flow collision
insights.rule: flow_frequency_conflicts for a contact-day pair exceeds a 5 percent share of active contacts in the trailing 7 days
insights.sentence: {n} contacts got messages from {k} flows on the same day this week

insights.name: deliverability drop
insights.rule: deliverability_inbox_placement falls more than 5 points versus its trailing 30-day average
insights.sentence: inbox placement dropped from {prev} to {now} percent this week

insights.name: stale segment
insights.rule: segment_freshness exceeds 7 days for a segment used by an active flow, while the underlying source data changed in that window
insights.sentence: {segment} has not recomputed in {n} days but still feeds {flow}

insights.name: discount fired too early
insights.rule: a cart or checkout abandonment flow's discount step index is at or before step 1 in flow_defs, against the brief's rule to hold discounts back
insights.sentence: {flow} offers a discount on message 1, before the shop-assistant follow-up gets a chance to work without one

insights.name: consent gap
insights.rule: a contact received a send on a channel with no matching valid consent record
insights.sentence: {n} sends this week went to contacts with no valid consent record on {channel}

insights.name: list decay
insights.rule: share of contacts with 0 opens or clicks in 180 days rises above 35 percent of the active list
insights.sentence: {pct} percent of your list has not engaged in 6 months, this is dragging deliverability down

insights.name: WhatsApp underused for high-value sends
insights.rule: a contact has a valid WhatsApp opt-in and a cart or order value above the brand's top quartile, but the send log shows SMS or email used instead
insights.sentence: {n} high-value sends this week used SMS or email even though the contact opted into WhatsApp

insights.name: welcome flow drop-off
insights.rule: the fall-off between two consecutive welcome steps exceeds twice the average step-to-step drop for that flow
insights.sentence: {pct} percent of new subscribers drop off between step {a} and step {b}

insights.name: win-back timing off brand cadence
insights.rule: the win-back flow's trigger delay is a fixed platform default rather than a value derived from this brand's own median days-between-orders
insights.sentence: win-back fires at {default} days but this brand's typical repeat buyer reorders at {median} days

insights.name: sunset not enforced
insights.rule: a contact has 0 opens across the last 6 sends and is still receiving campaigns, with no sunset flow entry logged
insights.sentence: {n} contacts with 6 unopened sends in a row are still being mailed campaigns

insights.name: test hygiene violation
insights.rule: a test in test_registry is marked complete with a sample size below its pre-registered minimum, or a read window shorter than pre-registered
insights.sentence: {test} was called before it reached {n} contacts or the {days}-day read window

insights.name: honesty rule breach
insights.rule: a live send contains a countdown timer or stock-scarcity claim with no matching inventory or time-limited-offer record
insights.sentence: {send} claims '{claim}' but there is no matching inventory or expiry record

insights.name: back-in-stock false trigger
insights.rule: a back-in-stock alert was sent for a SKU with no matching restock event in the inventory feed in the prior 24 hours
insights.sentence: a back-in-stock alert went out for {sku} with no restock event behind it

not_elsewhere.claim: Revenue by flow is counted from real orders matched to send logs, not from a click-attribution window that counts on send date and gives every touch its own credit
not_elsewhere.vs: Klaviyo's flow revenue reports revenue on the date the first message was sent, inside a configurable click window (default 5 days email, 1 day SMS), which can overstate or misdate a flow's real contribution

not_elsewhere.claim: One consent and quiet-hours record checked before every send across email, SMS and WhatsApp together
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Klaviyo and Gorgias separately for their own channel, but neither merges consent across every channel one brand sends on before a send goes out

not_elsewhere.claim: A pre-send honesty check that blocks a scarcity or countdown claim with no matching inventory or expiry record
not_elsewhere.vs: no ESP or SMS platform enforces this automatically; it is normally a manual copy-review step, if it happens at all

not_elsewhere.claim: Flow revenue mismatch between the platform's own report and real orders is surfaced as its own alert
not_elsewhere.vs: ESPs report their own attributed number with no way to see the gap against actual order data without exporting both and joining them by hand

not_elsewhere.claim: Test hygiene (minimum sample, pre-registered read window) is enforced across flows, campaigns and channels in one backlog
not_elsewhere.vs: Klaviyo's built-in A/B testing checks a single flow or campaign split, not a cross-channel test calendar with hygiene rules

not_elsewhere.claim: WhatsApp COD-to-prepaid conversion is tracked as its own metric tied to order data
not_elsewhere.vs: not a standard metric in Klaviyo, Gorgias or generic WhatsApp Business dashboards, which report delivery and read rates, not payment-method conversion

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, every metric shows unavailable and the room shows only the job list and empty chart frames, each with 'connect your ESP and order data to see this.' The first thing that lands once esp_sends and orders are connected is the flow revenue reconciliation chart and the consent-gap insight, since those need only 2 tables and catch the most urgent problems (money being miscounted, and sends that should not have gone out). WhatsApp-specific metrics stay unavailable until a WhatsApp Business or BSP feed is connected, which is normally the last piece for an Indian brand.
