metrics.name: repeat_purchase_rate
metrics.plain: Share of first-time buyers who order again within a set window
metrics.formula: customers with a 2nd order within 90 days ÷ customers with a 1st order in the cohort
metrics.window: rolling by acquisition month, viewed at 30/60/90/180 days
metrics.unavailable_when: orders lack a stable customer id
metrics.benchmark: varies hugely by category; compare within brand across cohorts, not to an outside number

metrics.name: cohort_gross_profit_ltv
metrics.plain: What a cohort of customers is actually worth in profit, not sales, over time
metrics.formula: cumulative (order revenue − COGS − payment fees − return/refund cost − shipping cost − support cost allocated to that customer) per customer, grouped by first-order month
metrics.window: by acquisition month, viewed to 3/6/12 months
metrics.unavailable_when: COGS or return cost data missing for the period
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; the target is LTV covering CAC within the brand's own payback window

metrics.name: cac_ltv_ratio
metrics.plain: Whether a customer is worth more than it cost to get them
metrics.formula: cohort_gross_profit_ltv at 180 days ÷ blended CAC for that cohort's acquisition channel
metrics.unavailable_when: CAC by cohort not available
metrics.benchmark: commonly cited healthy range is 3:1 or higher, but treat as directional

metrics.name: wismo_ticket_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders that generate a 'where is my order' contact
metrics.formula: tickets tagged as delivery-status ÷ total orders in the same window
metrics.unavailable_when: tickets are not tagged by reason
metrics.benchmark: under 5 percent of orders is a common target for a healthy tracking experience

metrics.name: rto_rate_cod
metrics.plain: Share of COD orders that come back undelivered
metrics.formula: RTO-flagged COD orders ÷ total COD orders shipped
metrics.window: trailing 30 and 90 days, by pincode or zone
metrics.unavailable_when: courier feed has no RTO flag
metrics.benchmark: India COD RTO commonly runs 15 to 30 percent depending on category and geography; compare to the brand's own trend and zone spread

metrics.name: return_rate
metrics.plain: Share of delivered orders that come back as a return or exchange
metrics.formula: returned units ÷ delivered units
metrics.window: trailing 90 days, by SKU and reason
metrics.unavailable_when: returns not logged with a SKU and reason
metrics.benchmark: varies by category; watch trend and reason mix, not a fixed number

metrics.name: refund_cycle_time
metrics.plain: How long a refund takes from request to money back
metrics.formula: median hours between return_requested_at and refund_issued_at
metrics.unavailable_when: either timestamp missing
metrics.benchmark: under 5 to 7 business days is a common customer expectation

metrics.name: nps_score
metrics.plain: Net promoter score from the standing survey
metrics.formula: percent promoters (9 to 10) minus percent detractors (0 to 6)
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 45 days without new responses
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 responses in the window
metrics.benchmark: no universal number; track trend and compare against own history

metrics.name: support_csat
metrics.plain: Average satisfaction score after a support interaction
metrics.formula: mean CSAT score from post-ticket surveys, 1 to 5 or thumbs scale normalized to percent
metrics.unavailable_when: CSAT survey not sent or response rate under 5 percent
metrics.benchmark: above 90 percent thumbs-up is a common healthy target

metrics.name: ticket_volume_by_reason
metrics.plain: How many tickets come in for each reason
metrics.formula: count of support_tickets grouped by reason_tag
metrics.unavailable_when: tickets untagged
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch which reason is growing fastest

metrics.name: first_response_time
metrics.plain: How fast support answers a new ticket
metrics.formula: median minutes between ticket opened and first agent or AI reply
metrics.unavailable_when: reply timestamp missing
metrics.benchmark: under 1 hour for chat/WhatsApp, under 24 hours for email is a common target

metrics.name: churn_risk_distribution
metrics.plain: How many customers sit in each churn-risk tier
metrics.formula: count of contacts per tier from the churn score (RFM decay + subscription pause events + unresolved tickets + engagement drop)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 90 days of order history
metrics.benchmark: no fixed split, watch the high-risk tier size over time

metrics.name: true_customer_profitability
metrics.plain: What a customer is actually worth after every real cost, not just what they spent
metrics.formula: customer revenue − returns/refund cost − support cost allocated (tickets × average handle cost) − shipping cost − discount cost given
metrics.source: orders + refunds + support_tickets + shipping cost table + discount_codes
metrics.window: trailing 12 months, per customer and per tier
metrics.unavailable_when: support cost or shipping cost cannot be allocated per order
metrics.benchmark: compare tiers to each other, not to an outside number

metrics.name: identity_match_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders, tickets and marketing contacts successfully merged into one profile per real person
metrics.formula: records matched to a unified profile ÷ total records checked (orders + tickets + ESP contacts + loyalty)
metrics.unavailable_when: identity resolution not run
metrics.benchmark: target close to 100 percent; a low rate understates real repeat rate and LTV

metrics.name: gst_credit_note_reconciliation_rate
metrics.plain: Share of completed refunds that have a matching, filed GST credit note
metrics.formula: refunds with a linked, filed credit_note_id ÷ total completed refunds
metrics.window: trailing month, checked monthly for GST filing
metrics.freshness_rule: recompute weekly, hard check before each GST filing date
metrics.unavailable_when: credit note system not linked to refunds
metrics.benchmark: target 100 percent before each filing deadline

metrics.name: dpdp_request_sla_compliance
metrics.plain: Share of data access or erasure requests handled inside the legal deadline
metrics.formula: requests resolved on or before their SLA deadline ÷ total requests received
metrics.freshness_rule: recompute daily while any request is open
metrics.unavailable_when: no dpdp_requests log kept
metrics.benchmark: target 100 percent, this is a legal obligation not a growth metric

metrics.name: ndr_reschedule_success_rate
metrics.plain: Share of failed COD delivery attempts that get successfully rebooked
metrics.formula: NDR'd orders successfully redelivered ÷ total NDR'd orders
metrics.unavailable_when: courier has no NDR event feed
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, compare couriers against each other

metrics.name: cx_maturity_score
metrics.plain: Whether CX decisions are random, intentional, or genuinely differentiated
metrics.formula: scored checklist against a written experience standard (LIFE-C30), not a computed ratio
metrics.source: manual scoring against the standard, logged with date
metrics.unavailable_when: no standard has been written yet
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, this is a maturity stage, not a number to beat

metrics.name: marketplace_review_rating
metrics.plain: Average public rating on marketplaces and Google, next to the on-site rating for the same product
metrics.formula: mean star rating per SKU, per source (Google Business Profile, Amazon, Flipkart, on-site)
metrics.unavailable_when: marketplace review pull not connected for that platform
metrics.benchmark: gap of more than 0.5 stars between on-site and marketplace rating for the same SKU is worth investigating

insights.name: silent churn risk
insights.rule: a customer's RFM recency decays past their own historical repurchase window, with no support contact and no email/SMS engagement in the same period
insights.sentence: {n} customers are past their usual reorder window with zero contact from us or to us

insights.name: refund without credit note
insights.rule: a refund is marked completed with no linked, filed GST credit note after 15 days
insights.sentence: {n} refunds from the last filing period have no matching credit note on file

insights.name: unprofitable VIP
insights.rule: a customer tagged VIP by revenue shows negative true_customer_profitability over the trailing 12 months
insights.sentence: {n} of your VIP customers are actually unprofitable once returns and support cost are counted

insights.name: unanswered negative review
insights.rule: a review rated 2 stars or lower has no response after 5 days
insights.sentence: {n} reviews at 2 stars or below have gone unanswered for over 5 days

insights.name: NDR loop
insights.rule: the same order has 2 or more failed delivery attempts with no successful reschedule
insights.sentence: order {id} has failed delivery {n} times with no successful rebooking

insights.name: crisis signal
insights.rule: mentions of one complaint theme across public channels (reviews, socials, forums) more than triples the trailing 14-day average in a single day
insights.sentence: mentions of '{theme}' are {n} times the normal rate today

insights.name: DPDP deadline at risk
insights.rule: an open data request is within 3 days of its legal SLA deadline and not yet resolved
insights.sentence: request {id} is due in {n} days and is still open

insights.name: identity fragmentation
insights.rule: the same phone number or email appears on more than one unmerged profile with orders on both
insights.sentence: {n} customers likely have 2 or more unmerged profiles, understating real repeat rate

insights.name: ticket reason drift
insights.rule: one reason_tag's share of total ticket volume grows more than 10 percentage points month over month
insights.sentence: '{reason}' tickets went from {a}% to {b}% of contacts this month

insights.name: RTO concentrated in one zone
insights.rule: a pincode cluster or courier shows an RTO rate more than double the brand's overall rate, with at least 20 orders in the window
insights.sentence: {zone} is running {n}x the average RTO rate on {count} orders this month

insights.name: marketplace rating gap
insights.rule: a SKU's marketplace rating is more than 0.5 stars below its on-site rating, with at least 10 marketplace reviews
insights.sentence: {sku} rates {onsite} stars on-site but only {market} on {platform}

insights.name: AI agent overreach
insights.rule: a logged AI support agent action exceeds its configured autonomy cap (refund amount, address change scope, or action type not on the approved list)
insights.sentence: the AI agent took action '{action}' worth {amount}, above its {cap} cap

insights.name: marketplace seller queue backlog
insights.rule: marketplace seller-support tickets aging past the marketplace's own SLA and still open
insights.sentence: {n} marketplace buyer messages on {platform} are past SLA and unanswered

insights.name: WISMO surge in one lane
insights.rule: wismo_ticket_rate for a shipping zone or courier exceeds 2x the brand overall rate
insights.sentence: {zone} is generating {n}x the normal share of 'where is my order' tickets

not_elsewhere.claim: Lifetime value is computed on gross profit after returns, support and discount cost, not on revenue
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's native LTV and cohort reports are revenue based and, outside Shopify Plus, do not offer cohort analysis at all; Triple Whale's cohort tools are also built on revenue and ad spend, not on returns and support cost netted out

not_elsewhere.claim: COD RTO and failed-delivery (NDR) reschedule outcomes are tracked as their own funnel tied to real courier events
not_elsewhere.vs: not a standard view in Klaviyo, Gorgias or Shopify analytics, which do not carry courier delivery-attempt data

not_elsewhere.claim: Support ticket reasons and CSAT are shown next to return, RTO and true-profitability data in one room
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Gorgias for ticket reasons and CSAT alone; Gorgias has no view of returns cost, RTO or per-customer profitability

not_elsewhere.claim: A single DPDP data-request register that tracks every system holding a person's data, with a legal SLA clock
not_elsewhere.vs: no ecommerce tool ships this off the shelf, since the data spans the ESP, helpdesk, loyalty app, POS and marketplace accounts a brand uses

not_elsewhere.claim: One merged customer identity across guest checkouts, phone, WhatsApp numbers, POS and marketplace orders before churn or LTV is scored
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify and most ESPs treat a guest checkout, a repeat email and a marketplace order as separate records unless a paid CDP is added; this identity resolution is a prerequisite step here, not an add-on

not_elsewhere.claim: An AI support agent's exact autonomy limits (refund cap, allowed action types) are logged and checked against every action it actually takes
not_elsewhere.vs: off-the-shelf AI helpdesk agents surface a config screen for the limits, but few log and flag when an action approaches or crosses that limit automatically

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows the job list and unavailable states everywhere except cx_maturity_score, which only needs a manual scoring session against a written standard. The first real signal once orders and refunds are connected is repeat_purchase_rate and return_rate; true_customer_profitability and cohort_gross_profit_ltv need support_tickets and product_costs on top of that, so they light up later. DPDP and GST reconciliation fields are the hardest to get since they live outside any marketing or CX tool, in accounting and a manual compliance log.

metrics.name: margin_after_discount
metrics.plain: What is actually left after the discount, in rupees, not just percent off
metrics.formula: order revenue − COGS − payment fee − discount amount, per order and rolled up per offer
metrics.unavailable_when: COGS missing for a SKU in the order
metrics.benchmark: compare against the founder's own red-line margin, set per offer

metrics.name: free_shipping_threshold_breakeven
metrics.plain: The order value at which free shipping stops costing margin
metrics.formula: AOV + (average shipping cost ÷ gross margin rate), recomputed from the brand's live numbers
metrics.window: recomputed monthly or when AOV/margin shifts more than 5 percent
metrics.freshness_rule: flag stale if AOV or shipping cost has moved over 5 percent since last computed
metrics.unavailable_when: shipping cost per order not tracked separately
metrics.benchmark: a common range is 20 to 30 percent above current AOV, but the brand's own break-even number is what matters

metrics.name: discount_dependency_rate
metrics.plain: Share of revenue that only came in at a discount
metrics.formula: revenue from orders with a discount code or automatic discount ÷ total revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: discount flag missing on the order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch the trend line for creep

metrics.name: discount_frequency_per_customer
metrics.plain: How often the same customer buys only when there is a discount
metrics.formula: count of discounted orders ÷ total orders, per repeat customer
metrics.unavailable_when: customer id missing on some orders
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; a rising trend per customer signals trained-to-wait behavior

metrics.name: bundle_attach_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders that take the bundle instead of a single item
metrics.formula: bundle orders ÷ (bundle orders + single-item orders for the same product line)
metrics.unavailable_when: bundle SKU not distinguished from single SKU
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; compare tiers against each other

metrics.name: average_selling_price_trend
metrics.plain: Whether the real price paid, after discounts, is rising or falling over time
metrics.formula: total revenue ÷ total units, monthly
metrics.unavailable_when: unit count missing on an order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch direction relative to list price

metrics.name: gwp_cost_share
metrics.plain: What the free gift costs as a share of the order it is attached to
metrics.formula: gift COGS ÷ order revenue, for orders that received the gift
metrics.unavailable_when: gift COGS not entered
metrics.benchmark: compare against the cap the founder set when the gift was designed

metrics.name: upsell_take_rate
metrics.plain: Share of eligible customers who accept an upsell or cross-sell offer
metrics.formula: orders that included the upsell ÷ orders shown the upsell, by placement (cart, checkout, post-purchase)
metrics.unavailable_when: the placement does not log an impression
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; compare placements to each other

metrics.name: guarantee_claim_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders covered by the guarantee that actually file a claim
metrics.formula: guarantee claims ÷ orders covered by that guarantee, in the guarantee's window
metrics.source: refunds tagged as guarantee claims + orders
metrics.unavailable_when: claims not tagged separately from ordinary returns
metrics.benchmark: compare against the claim-rate assumption used when the guarantee was priced

metrics.name: subscription_perk_redemption_rate
metrics.plain: Share of subscribers who actually use a given perk
metrics.formula: perk redemptions ÷ active subscribers eligible for that perk
metrics.unavailable_when: redemption not logged per perk
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target; a very low rate signals the wrong perk

metrics.name: cancel_flow_save_rate
metrics.plain: Share of subscribers who accept the save offer instead of cancelling
metrics.formula: saves ÷ (saves + completed cancellations)
metrics.unavailable_when: cancel-flow steps not logged
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure, watch trend over time

metrics.name: popup_offer_net_economics
metrics.plain: Whether the pop-up offer pays for itself once every cost is counted
metrics.formula: incremental revenue from pop-up-sourced first orders − (discount cost + ESP cost allocated to those contacts)
metrics.source: orders + consent_log signup source + discount_codes + ESP cost
metrics.unavailable_when: signup source not tagged on the contact
metrics.benchmark: target positive net; compare against the model built before launch (LIFE-C44)

metrics.name: referral_program_cac
metrics.plain: Cost to acquire a customer through referral, versus paid CAC
metrics.formula: total referral reward cost ÷ number of referred customers who placed an order
metrics.unavailable_when: referral source not tagged on the order
metrics.benchmark: compare directly against blended paid CAC for the same period

metrics.name: bnpl_trial_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of trial or BNPL starts that convert to the full-price plan
metrics.formula: trials converted to full price ÷ trials started
metrics.unavailable_when: trial conversion not logged
metrics.benchmark: compare against the conversion assumption used when the trial was priced

metrics.name: map_violation_count
metrics.plain: Number of listings selling below the agreed minimum advertised price
metrics.formula: count of marketplace_listings rows where listed_price < map_price
metrics.unavailable_when: a marketplace or reseller is not covered by the price pull
metrics.benchmark: target zero

metrics.name: competitor_price_index
metrics.plain: The brand's price versus named competitors, indexed
metrics.formula: brand price ÷ average of named competitors' price for the matched product, per SKU family
metrics.freshness_rule: recompute on each competitor price pull
metrics.unavailable_when: no matched competitor SKU found
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch material moves (over 5 percent) more than the absolute index

metrics.name: gift_card_liability_outstanding
metrics.plain: Total value of gift cards sold but not yet redeemed
metrics.formula: sum of issued_value − sum of redeemed_value, across active cards
metrics.unavailable_when: gift card ledger not exported
metrics.benchmark: no fixed target, watch growth rate against redemption rate

metrics.name: gift_card_redemption_rate
metrics.plain: Share of issued gift card value that gets redeemed
metrics.formula: redeemed value ÷ issued value, for cards past their typical redemption window
metrics.window: trailing 12 months of issuance, redemption tracked ongoing
metrics.unavailable_when: issuance date missing
metrics.benchmark: no universal figure; a falling rate alongside rising liability is the flag

metrics.name: offer_test_backlog_status
metrics.plain: What is queued, running or done in the offer test backlog, and the win rate
metrics.formula: count and status of entries in the offer test registry; win rate = tests won ÷ tests completed
metrics.unavailable_when: test_registry not kept for offers specifically
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number, watch hygiene violations alongside win rate

insights.name: discount creep
insights.rule: discount_dependency_rate rises more than 5 percentage points over the trailing 3 months
insights.sentence: discounted revenue went from {a}% to {b}% of sales over the last 3 months

insights.name: margin red line breach
insights.rule: margin_after_discount for a live offer falls below the founder's stated red-line margin
insights.sentence: {offer} is running at {margin}% margin, below your {redline}% red line

insights.name: MAP violation detected
insights.rule: map_violation_count > 0 for a listing in the current check
insights.sentence: {n} listings on {marketplace} are priced below the agreed MAP of {map_price}

insights.name: free shipping threshold stale
insights.rule: free_shipping_threshold_breakeven has not been recomputed since AOV or shipping cost moved more than 5 percent
insights.sentence: your free shipping threshold was set when AOV was {old}, it is now {new}

insights.name: bundle cannibalizing full price
insights.rule: bundle_attach_rate is high (over 40 percent) while average_selling_price_trend for the product line is falling faster than the bundle's per-unit discount would explain
insights.sentence: the bundle is winning {pct}% of orders but per-unit price is falling faster than the bundle discount accounts for

insights.name: gift cost creep with no lift
insights.rule: gwp_cost_share rises without a matching rise in average_selling_price_trend or bundle_attach_rate for the tier the gift was meant to lift
insights.sentence: the gift now costs {pct}% of order value with no lift in the tier it was meant to push

insights.name: guarantee cost above plan
insights.rule: guarantee_claim_rate exceeds the claim-rate assumption used to price the guarantee by more than 50 percent relative
insights.sentence: claims are running at {actual}%, against a planned {planned}%

insights.name: trial conversion miss
insights.rule: bnpl_trial_conversion_rate falls more than 20 percent relative below the modeled conversion used to price the trial
insights.sentence: trial-to-full conversion is {actual}%, against a modeled {planned}%

insights.name: competitor price move
insights.rule: competitor_price_index moves more than 5 percent in either direction for a named competitor's matched SKU family within a week
insights.sentence: {competitor} moved price {pct}% on {product} this week

insights.name: referral beats paid CAC
insights.rule: referral_program_cac is less than half of blended paid CAC for the same period
insights.sentence: referral CAC is {referral}, less than half of paid CAC at {paid}

insights.name: overlapping offer tests
insights.rule: two entries in the offer test_registry target the same product or segment with overlapping date ranges
insights.sentence: {test_a} and {test_b} are both running on {segment} at the same time, results cannot be trusted

insights.name: gift card liability outpacing redemption
insights.rule: gift_card_liability_outstanding grows faster than gift_card_redemption_rate over 3 consecutive months
insights.sentence: outstanding gift card liability has grown {pct}% while redemption has not kept pace

insights.name: subscription perk mismatch
insights.rule: subscription_perk_redemption_rate for a perk stays under 10 percent for 2 consecutive months
insights.sentence: only {pct}% of subscribers use the '{perk}' perk 2 months running

insights.name: cancel save rate falling
insights.rule: cancel_flow_save_rate drops more than 10 percentage points versus its trailing 90-day average
insights.sentence: the cancel-flow save offer worked {old}% of the time, now {new}%

insights.name: competitor policy change
insights.rule: a named competitor's public returns, loyalty or subscription-terms page changes materially since the last check
insights.sentence: {competitor} changed its {policy_type} page: {change}

visuals.name: margin waterfall
visuals.shows: revenue down to net margin for a chosen offer or discount, step by step
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder needs to see exactly where money leaves before approving an offer, not just a final percent

visuals.name: discount dependency trend
visuals.shows: share of revenue at a discount, monthly, over the trailing 12 months
visuals.why_this_chart: discount creep is invisible month to month but obvious as a trend line

visuals.name: free shipping threshold sensitivity
visuals.shows: break-even threshold recalculated as AOV, margin or shipping cost inputs change
visuals.why_this_chart: shows the founder the current live number and how sensitive it is to what just changed

visuals.name: competitor price index
visuals.shows: brand price index versus each named competitor over time
visuals.why_this_chart: a single moment snapshot hides a slow squeeze; the line shows the trend

visuals.name: bundle ladder funnel
visuals.shows: share of orders choosing each tier in the ladder, single item to largest bundle
visuals.why_this_chart: shows whether the pre-selected middle option is actually winning

visuals.name: offer test backlog board
visuals.shows: offer tests planned, running, done, with hygiene flags
visuals.why_this_chart: keeps one variable tested at a time visible instead of buried in separate documents

visuals.name: gift card liability vs redemption
visuals.shows: outstanding liability and redemption rate over time
visuals.why_this_chart: liability growth is a cash-flow risk that is easy to miss without seeing both lines together

not_elsewhere.claim: The free shipping threshold is computed straight from this brand's own live AOV, margin and shipping cost, and flagged stale automatically when those inputs move
not_elsewhere.vs: standalone calculators such as Funnelytics or Cartylabs use the same break-even formula but need the numbers typed in by hand each time, with no link to the brand's own order data and no automatic re-check

not_elsewhere.claim: A margin waterfall runs before an offer launches, and a founder-set red line blocks approval if it is crossed
not_elsewhere.vs: no researched tool ties a margin model to a hard approval gate before an offer goes live; discount apps in Shopify show usage after the fact, not a pre-launch margin check

not_elsewhere.claim: Discount dependency and price integrity are tracked as one running score across every offer and channel, not just a discount-usage count
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's and most ESPs' discount reports show redemption counts and revenue per code, not a trained-to-wait signal across the whole account

not_elsewhere.claim: Competitor and MAP price tracking is tied directly into the brand's own offer test backlog and margin data
not_elsewhere.vs: standalone MAP-monitoring services flag violations but do not connect to the brand's own cost and margin data to show what a match or hold would actually cost

not_elsewhere.claim: Offer tests are checked for overlap (same segment, same window, two variables at once) automatically before a founder is asked to read results
not_elsewhere.vs: most brands track offer tests in a spreadsheet with no automatic overlap check, so a confounded result can look clean

not_elsewhere.claim: Gift card liability and redemption are shown together as a cash-flow signal, not just a balance
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's native gift card report shows a balance, not a trend of liability growth against redemption pace

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows the job list, empty chart frames and one usable tile: the margin waterfall template, which a founder can fill by hand before any data is connected since it only needs a proposed price, COGS and discount. The first real numbers to land once orders and product_costs are connected are margin_after_discount and discount_dependency_rate. Competitor and MAP pricing depend on the agent's own public web pulls and are the hardest to keep current, since prices change without notice and matching a competitor's SKU to the brand's own is manual work the first time.

metrics.name: posting_floor_adherence
metrics.plain: Share of this week's planned posts that actually went out
metrics.formula: posts_published_this_week / posts_planned_at_floor_this_week
metrics.unavailable_when: no calendar connected or no floor set
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, compares to the brand's own set floor

metrics.name: festive_slot_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of festivals in the next 30 days that already have a script assigned
metrics.formula: festival_slots_with_script / festival_slots_in_next_30_days
metrics.unavailable_when: no festive calendar layer loaded

metrics.name: founder_camera_share
metrics.plain: Share of published posts that feature the founder on camera
metrics.formula: founder_posts / total_posts, trailing 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: posts are not tagged for on-camera presence

metrics.name: revenue_from_tagged_content
metrics.plain: Orders that came from a specific post, tracked by its own link tag or promo code
metrics.formula: sum(order_value) where session utm_content or promo code matches a post id, within its view-through window
metrics.source: store orders joined to analytics UTM/promo-code table
metrics.unavailable_when: the post's link carries no UTM tag or promo code

metrics.name: content_pillar_revenue_share
metrics.plain: Share of tagged content revenue coming from each pillar
metrics.formula: revenue_from_tagged_content grouped by pillar / total tagged revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 tagged orders in the window

metrics.name: link_destination_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of live posts whose link opens a working page that matches the post
metrics.formula: posts_with_verified_live_matching_link / posts_checked
metrics.window: checked daily on all posts from the last 90 days
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without a check
metrics.unavailable_when: no link-check run in 48 hours

metrics.name: shoppable_tag_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of eligible posts with correct product tags attached
metrics.formula: posts_with_correct_product_tag / posts_eligible_for_tagging
metrics.source: platform catalog tagging API + calendar plan
metrics.unavailable_when: catalog tagging API not connected

metrics.name: comment_response_time_median
metrics.plain: Typical time to the first reply on a comment or DM that needs one
metrics.formula: median(first_reply_time - message_time) for messages flagged as needing a reply
metrics.unavailable_when: no inbox log connected
metrics.benchmark: under 1 hour on the hero platform

metrics.name: dm_to_owned_contact_rate
metrics.plain: Share of DM conversations that end with an email, WhatsApp opt-in or phone number captured
metrics.formula: dm_threads_with_captured_contact / dm_threads_total
metrics.unavailable_when: no DM funnel or CRM link

metrics.name: ugc_pipeline_depth
metrics.plain: Verified reviews and UGC assets ready to post, by SKU
metrics.formula: count(verified_ugc_assets) where posted = false, grouped by sku
metrics.freshness_rule: recomputed on each new review import
metrics.unavailable_when: no UGC intake table

metrics.name: asset_reuse_rate
metrics.plain: Share of assets past their reuse checkpoint that got reused on at least one other surface
metrics.formula: assets_reused_before_shelf_life_end / assets_past_reuse_checkpoint
metrics.unavailable_when: assets are not tagged with a shelf-life date

metrics.name: creator_seeding_active_count
metrics.plain: Creators currently seeded with product this month, and total product cost sent
metrics.formula: count(distinct creator) and sum(product_cost) where seeding_status = active
metrics.unavailable_when: no seeding tracker

metrics.name: creator_content_yield
metrics.plain: Content pieces delivered per 10 creators seeded
metrics.formula: 10 * count(content_delivered) / count(distinct creator seeded)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 creators seeded in the window

metrics.name: claims_gate_hold_count
metrics.plain: Posts the safety gate held before publish this month, and the most common rule triggered
metrics.formula: count(posts) where gate_result = held, grouped by rule
metrics.unavailable_when: claims gate not running on this account

metrics.name: stranger_blind_share
metrics.plain: Share of the top 10 posts by reach that name no product and give no next step
metrics.formula: count(top_10_reach_posts where no_named_sku and no_cta) / 10
metrics.unavailable_when: posts are not tagged for SKU or CTA

metrics.name: broad_low_value_hit_share
metrics.plain: Share of top-quartile-reach posts whose matched orders fall below the brand's set floor
metrics.formula: count(top_quartile_reach posts where matched_orders < floor) / count(top_quartile_reach posts)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 10 posts in the top quartile

metrics.name: youtube_search_traffic_share
metrics.plain: Share of channel views coming from YouTube search rather than suggested or browse
metrics.formula: search_views / total_views
metrics.unavailable_when: YouTube Studio not connected

metrics.name: community_active_member_rate
metrics.plain: Share of community members who sent at least one message in the last 30 days
metrics.formula: active_members_30d / total_members
metrics.unavailable_when: no community roster export

metrics.name: community_to_order_rate
metrics.plain: Share of community members who also placed an order in the same window, matched by phone or email
metrics.formula: members_with_matching_order / total_members
metrics.source: community roster matched to orders (phone match for WhatsApp)
metrics.unavailable_when: roster cannot be matched to orders (no shared phone/email field)

insights.name: posting floor missed
insights.rule: posts_published this week < posts_planned at floor
insights.sentence: {n} of {planned} planned posts did not go out this week
insights.severity: high if 2+ weeks running, else medium

insights.name: festive gap
insights.rule: a festival is within 14 days and has zero assigned script
insights.sentence: {festival} is in {d} days and has no script yet

insights.name: stranger-blind viral post
insights.rule: a post is in the top 3 by reach in the last 30 days and carries no named SKU or CTA tag
insights.sentence: {title} got {reach} views but named no product and gave no next step

insights.name: broad low-value hit
insights.rule: a post is in the top reach quartile and its matched orders fall below the set floor
insights.sentence: {title} reached {n} people but sold {k} pieces, below the {floor} floor

insights.name: unused UGC
insights.rule: a verified review or photo asset has sat unposted for more than 21 days
insights.sentence: {n} verified reviews are unused for over {d} days

insights.name: asset expiring unused
insights.rule: an asset's shelf-life end date is within 7 days and its reuse count is 0
insights.sentence: {n} assets retire this week without being reused anywhere

insights.name: claims gate catching a real pattern
insights.rule: the same claims rule triggers 3 or more times in a month
insights.sentence: {n} posts were held this month for {top_rule}, more than any other rule

insights.name: creator seeding, no yield
insights.rule: a creator was seeded more than 21 days ago and has delivered zero content
insights.sentence: {n} of {seeded} creators sent product but delivered nothing in 3 weeks

insights.name: DM funnel leak
insights.rule: the share of DM threads ending with no captured contact exceeds 70%
insights.sentence: {pct}% of DM conversations end without an email, WhatsApp opt-in or phone number

insights.name: dead or mismatched link
insights.rule: a live post's link fails the check or does not match the intended page
insights.sentence: {n} live posts point to a page that is down or does not match

insights.name: comment response lag
insights.rule: a comment or DM needing a reply has waited more than 24 hours
insights.sentence: {n} messages have waited over {h} hours for a reply

insights.name: community going quiet
insights.rule: active member rate falls 10 percentage points or more month over month
insights.sentence: community activity fell {pct} points this month

insights.name: YouTube search share falling
insights.rule: search-traffic share this period is lower than the prior period
insights.sentence: {pct}% of views now come from search, down from {prev}%

insights.name: founder over budget

insights.sentence: {pct}% of posts need the founder on camera, above the {target}% plan

metrics.name: organic_sessions
metrics.plain: Visits that came from unpaid search
metrics.formula: GA4 sessions where default channel group = Organic Search
metrics.unavailable_when: GA4 not connected

metrics.name: organic_revenue
metrics.plain: Store revenue from orders that started with an unpaid search visit
metrics.formula: sum(order_value) where first-touch session channel = organic search, joined by session id or converted client id
metrics.source: GA4 sessions joined to store orders
metrics.unavailable_when: GA4-to-orders join is not configured

metrics.name: organic_revenue_share
metrics.plain: Share of total store revenue that organic search brought in
metrics.formula: organic_revenue / total_store_revenue, same window
metrics.unavailable_when: organic_revenue is unavailable

metrics.name: keyword_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of the buyer-question map that has a live page ranking in the top 20
metrics.formula: keywords_with_page_rank_le_20 / keywords_in_map
metrics.unavailable_when: no rank tracker connected

metrics.name: page1_keyword_count
metrics.plain: Number of mapped keywords ranking in the top 10, and the change from last month
metrics.formula: count(keywords where rank <= 10), delta vs 30 days ago
metrics.unavailable_when: no rank tracker connected

metrics.name: ctr_by_query_group
metrics.plain: Click-through rate for branded vs non-branded search queries
metrics.formula: clicks / impressions, grouped by branded vs non-branded query classification
metrics.unavailable_when: Search Console not connected
metrics.benchmark: non-branded CTR at position 1 typically 25 to 35%

metrics.name: indexed_page_ratio
metrics.plain: Share of submitted sitemap pages that Google has actually indexed
metrics.formula: indexed_pages / submitted_pages
metrics.unavailable_when: Search Console not connected
metrics.benchmark: over 95% for a catalog this size

metrics.name: crawl_error_count
metrics.plain: Pages returning a broken status, a bad redirect or a redirect chain, on the latest crawl
metrics.formula: count(pages) where status in (4xx, 5xx) or redirect_hops >= 3
metrics.unavailable_when: no crawl run in 7 days

metrics.name: orphan_page_count
metrics.plain: Pages with zero internal links pointing to them
metrics.formula: count(pages) where internal_inlinks = 0
metrics.unavailable_when: no crawl run in 7 days

metrics.name: schema_validation_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of product and collection pages with valid, error-free schema
metrics.formula: pages_with_valid_schema / money_pages_checked
metrics.source: structured-data validator run against money pages
metrics.unavailable_when: no validator run in 7 days

metrics.name: content_refresh_backlog_value
metrics.plain: Total revenue-at-risk sitting in pages flagged for refresh, ranked
metrics.formula: sum(page_trailing_90d_revenue) for pages where clicks fell 20%+ over 90 days and not refreshed
metrics.source: GSC clicks history + organic_revenue by page
metrics.unavailable_when: page-level revenue join not configured

metrics.name: referring_domains_new
metrics.plain: New unique domains linking to the site this month
metrics.formula: count(distinct referring_domain) first seen this month
metrics.unavailable_when: no backlink index connected

metrics.name: link_velocity_by_source
metrics.plain: New links split by tactic: PR, guest post, broken-link, review-site
metrics.formula: count(new_links) grouped by outreach_tactic tag
metrics.unavailable_when: outreach tactic not tagged on the link

metrics.name: gbp_review_rate
metrics.plain: New Google Business Profile reviews this month and the average rating
metrics.formula: count(new_reviews), avg(rating)
metrics.unavailable_when: no physical location or GBP not connected

metrics.name: tag_health_score
metrics.plain: Share of key events (page view, add to cart, purchase) firing correctly on the last audit
metrics.formula: events_firing_correctly / key_events_checked
metrics.window: monthly, checked on demand after any theme change
metrics.unavailable_when: no tag audit run this cycle

metrics.name: cwv_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of the top page templates passing Core Web Vitals
metrics.formula: templates_passing / templates_checked, using field or lab data
metrics.unavailable_when: no speed run in 7 days

metrics.name: discontinued_page_handling_rate
metrics.plain: Share of out-of-stock or discontinued product pages that redirect properly instead of 404ing
metrics.formula: pages_redirected_or_kept_with_alternatives / discontinued_pages
metrics.unavailable_when: no redirect map maintained

insights.name: unexplained traffic drop
insights.rule: organic_sessions falls 15% or more week over week with no logged algorithm update or seasonal cause
insights.sentence: organic visits fell {pct}% this week with no known cause logged

insights.name: CTR mismatch
insights.rule: a page's impressions rank in the top 20% and its CTR sits 30% or more below the branded/non-branded benchmark for its position
insights.sentence: {page} gets {impressions} impressions but a CTR of only {ctr}%, well under what position {pos} should get

insights.name: keyword cannibalization
insights.rule: 2 or more pages rank for the same primary keyword within 5 positions of each other
insights.sentence: {n} pages compete for '{keyword}', splitting the ranking signal

insights.name: orphan money page
insights.rule: a page in the keyword map has zero internal inlinks
insights.sentence: {page} targets '{keyword}' but gets no internal links from anywhere on the site

insights.name: stale high-value page
insights.rule: a page in the top 20% of pages by organic_revenue has clicks down 20% or more over 90 days and has not been refreshed in 180 days
insights.sentence: {page} makes {revenue} a month but clicks fell {pct}% and it has not been touched in {days} days

insights.name: broken schema on a money page
insights.rule: a product or collection page's schema fails validation
insights.sentence: {n} product pages have broken {schema_type} schema

insights.name: long redirect chain
insights.rule: a URL has 3 or more redirect hops before landing
insights.sentence: {n} URLs take {hops} redirects to load, slowing crawl and the visitor

insights.name: discontinued page 404ing
insights.rule: an out-of-stock or discontinued product page returns a 404 or soft-404 instead of a redirect to a live alternative
insights.sentence: {n} discontinued product pages 404 instead of pointing buyers somewhere live

insights.name: outreach not landing links
insights.rule: 60 or more outreach pitches sent in 60 days produced zero new referring domains
insights.sentence: no new links from {n} pitches sent in the last {days} days

insights.name: unanswered reviews
insights.rule: a Google Business Profile review has gone unanswered for more than 7 days
insights.sentence: {n} reviews have waited over a week for a reply

insights.name: tag stopped firing
insights.rule: a key GA4 event's daily count drops to zero for 2 or more consecutive days
insights.sentence: the {event} tag stopped firing on {date}

insights.name: AI crawler blocked on a money page
insights.rule: robots.txt disallows a known AI crawler (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) on a page in the keyword map
insights.sentence: {n} money pages block {crawler} from reading them

insights.name: vendor claim does not hold up
insights.rule: a vendor-cited stat about the site differs from the brand's own analytics by 20% or more
insights.sentence: the vendor claims {vendor_stat} but our own data shows {actual_stat}

visuals.name: keyword rank movement
visuals.shows: count of page-1 keywords over time

visuals.name: crawl health treemap
visuals.shows: pages sized by traffic, colored by health status (healthy, warning, broken)
visuals.why_this_chart: founder sees which broken pages actually matter

visuals.name: content refresh priority table

visuals.name: internal link graph snippet
visuals.shows: money pages and their inlink count, orphans highlighted
visuals.why_this_chart: makes an invisible problem (orphan pages) visible in one glance

metrics.name: ai_mention_rate
metrics.plain: Share of the frozen prompt set where the brand is mentioned at all, per engine
metrics.formula: prompts_mentioning_brand / prompts_in_set, grouped by engine
metrics.window: monthly, per engine (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode)
metrics.unavailable_when: the prompt set has not run this cycle for that engine

metrics.name: ai_recommend_rate
metrics.plain: Share of prompts where the brand is named as a recommended option, not just mentioned
metrics.formula: prompts_recommending_brand / prompts_in_set, grouped by engine
metrics.unavailable_when: prompt set has not run this cycle

metrics.name: ai_share_of_voice
metrics.plain: Brand mentions as a share of all named-brand mentions (brand plus named competitors) in the same prompt set
metrics.formula: brand_mentions / (brand_mentions + competitor_mentions)
metrics.unavailable_when: no competitor prompt runs to compare against

metrics.name: ai_sentiment_score
metrics.plain: Share of brand mentions classified positive under a fixed rubric
metrics.formula: positive_mentions / total_mentions
metrics.unavailable_when: mentions not yet classified

metrics.name: fact_gap_count
metrics.plain: Gaps found in the last prompt audit, by category (price, materials, returns, shipping, COD, warranty)
metrics.formula: count(gaps) from the last audit, grouped by category
metrics.unavailable_when: no audit run this cycle

metrics.name: fact_gap_closed_rate
metrics.plain: Share of the last audit's gaps that now have a published fix
metrics.formula: gaps_with_published_fix / gaps_found
metrics.unavailable_when: no audit to compare against

metrics.name: fact_consistency_score
metrics.plain: Share of core facts that read identically across site, schema, feed and tracked directories
metrics.formula: facts_matching_everywhere / facts_checked
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 surfaces are tracked for a fact

metrics.name: citation_source_share
metrics.plain: Of the sources an engine cites when it answers about the brand, the share that are brand-owned
metrics.formula: brand_owned_citations / total_citations
metrics.unavailable_when: the engine's answer includes no visible citations

metrics.name: wrong_fact_count_open
metrics.plain: Confirmed wrong AI-stated facts not yet corrected at any level
metrics.formula: count(corrections) where status = open
metrics.unavailable_when: no corrections log

metrics.name: correction_landed_rate
metrics.plain: Share of corrections confirmed fixed on re-check after the set cadence
metrics.formula: corrections_confirmed_on_recheck / corrections_rechecked
metrics.window: since correction shipped, checked at 14 and 30 days
metrics.unavailable_when: no re-check has run yet for that correction

metrics.name: correction_lag_days
metrics.plain: Typical days from a wrong fact confirmed to the site-level fix published
metrics.formula: median(site_fix_date - confirmed_date)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 3 closed corrections

metrics.name: citable_page_count
metrics.plain: Pages rewritten to the answer-first, atomic-fact format, out of the priority list
metrics.formula: pages_rewritten / pages_on_priority_list
metrics.unavailable_when: no priority list set

metrics.name: agentic_listing_accuracy
metrics.plain: Share of checked fields (price, stock, variant, delivery estimate) a shopping-agent-style query returns correctly
metrics.formula: fields_matching_live_feed / fields_checked
metrics.source: agentic listing spot-check against the live product feed
metrics.unavailable_when: no spot-check run in 7 days

metrics.name: competitor_ai_narrative_change_count
metrics.plain: Detected changes this week in how an engine describes a named competitor
metrics.formula: count(narrative_changes) from the weekly competitor prompt slice
metrics.unavailable_when: weekly brief did not run

metrics.name: engine_coverage
metrics.plain: Which engines are currently in the monitored set
metrics.formula: list of engines with a successful run in the last 35 days
metrics.freshness_rule: flag any engine missing for 35+ days
metrics.unavailable_when: no engine has run successfully

insights.name: engine invents a fact
insights.rule: an engine's answer states a specific number or claim that does not match the facts registry
insights.sentence: {engine} told a buyer {claim}, which is not on our facts page

insights.name: recommend gap versus a competitor
insights.rule: an engine mentions the brand but recommends a named competitor for the same prompt
insights.sentence: {engine} named {competitor} instead of us for '{prompt}'

insights.name: fact drift across surfaces
insights.rule: the same fact reads with a different value on two tracked surfaces
insights.sentence: {fact} says {value_a} on the site and {value_b} on the feed

insights.name: correction did not land
insights.rule: a correction shipped N days ago and the re-check still returns the old fact
insights.sentence: {n} days after we fixed it, {engine} still says the old {fact}

insights.name: no brand-owned citation
insights.rule: an engine's answers about the brand cite zero brand-owned sources across the last audit
insights.sentence: {engine} never cites our own site when it answers about us

insights.name: shopping agent gets it wrong
insights.rule: an agentic listing spot-check returns a price or stock value that does not match the live feed
insights.sentence: {n} products show the wrong {field} to a shopping agent

insights.name: sentiment slide
insights.rule: ai_sentiment_score for an engine falls versus the prior month
insights.sentence: {engine}'s positive mentions fell {pct} points this month

insights.name: competitor narrative shift
insights.rule: a named competitor's described strengths changed between this week's and last week's prompt slice
insights.sentence: {engine} now says {competitor} is {new_claim}, it did not say that last week

insights.name: stale prompt set
insights.rule: the prompt set has not run for an engine in more than 35 days
insights.sentence: the AI-visibility check has not run on {engine} in {d} days

insights.name: citable rewrite backlog stalling
insights.rule: a page on the priority rewrite list has sat unrewritten for more than 4 weeks
insights.sentence: {n} priority pages are still not rewritten for citation after {weeks} weeks

insights.name: known but not recommended
insights.rule: ai_mention_rate is high (over 60%) while ai_recommend_rate is low (under 20%) for the same engine
insights.sentence: {engine} knows us in {pct}% of prompts but recommends us in only {rec_pct}%

metrics.name: demand_screen_result
metrics.plain: Whether a candidate passed the first fast check
metrics.formula: pass/fail flag from the demand, competition and store-fit rule set applied to the candidate
metrics.window: at screening, refreshed if the candidate is rescreened
metrics.unavailable_when: candidate has not been screened yet
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; internal pass rate tracked over time

metrics.name: video_commerce_demand_signal
metrics.plain: How strong the social/video demand signal is, and from how many sources
metrics.formula: count of independent platforms and creators showing sustained views or sell-through above the category median, not a single clip
metrics.source: video-commerce and social-native platform pulls (TikTok-style shop data, native ad feeds)
metrics.unavailable_when: no pull run for this candidate
metrics.benchmark: 2 or more independent sources required before treating it as real (internal rule, no external benchmark)

metrics.name: ad_library_spend_signal
metrics.plain: How many advertisers keep spending on this product idea, and for how long
metrics.formula: count of distinct advertisers with an ad live for more than 90 days in public ad libraries for the candidate's category
metrics.unavailable_when: no ad library capture run for this candidate
metrics.benchmark: 3+ advertisers past 90 days is treated as a sustained-spend signal (internal rule)

metrics.name: research_time_used
metrics.plain: Hours spent researching this candidate against its budget
metrics.formula: sum of logged research hours for the candidate ÷ the time box set for its research stage
metrics.window: life of the candidate's research stage
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 2 days without a log entry
metrics.unavailable_when: no time box has been set
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; time box is set per brand

metrics.name: trend_direction_score
metrics.plain: Whether the category is growing, flat or shrinking over several years
metrics.formula: slope of a multi-year search or sales trend index, normalised to a -1 to 1 score
metrics.unavailable_when: trend series not pulled for this category
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; read together with competitive_saturation_count

metrics.name: competitive_saturation_count
metrics.plain: How many sellers already compete in this category
metrics.formula: count of distinct active sellers or listings found for the category across the channels checked
metrics.unavailable_when: no scan run for this category
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; rising trend with low count is the target combination

metrics.name: demand_pattern_tag
metrics.plain: Evergreen, seasonal or trending label for the candidate
metrics.formula: rule-based tag from the trend series shape (flat, spiking, or one-off) plus review and search seasonality
metrics.unavailable_when: trend series too short to classify (under 12 months of data)
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a label not a score

metrics.name: review_price_signal
metrics.plain: The price buyers say in reviews they would actually pay
metrics.formula: median of price mentions extracted from 1 to 5 star reviews on competing products in the category
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 price mentions found
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; compared against the candidate's planned price

metrics.name: review_complaint_rate
metrics.plain: How often the same unmet complaint shows up in competitor reviews
metrics.formula: count of reviews mentioning the top recurring complaint ÷ total reviews mined for that competitor product
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 reviews mined
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; a rate above 15% is treated internally as a real gap

metrics.name: contribution_margin_pct_modelled
metrics.plain: The margin the gate model expects after price, cost, shipping and duty
metrics.formula: (planned price − COGS − shipping − duty − payment fee) ÷ planned price
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any input cost change of more than 3%
metrics.unavailable_when: gate has not been run for this candidate
metrics.benchmark: brand-set minimum contribution margin threshold (set once per brand, not hard-coded)

metrics.name: contribution_margin_pct_actual
metrics.plain: The margin a launched SKU is really making, from real sales
metrics.formula: (actual revenue − actual COGS − allocated shipping − allocated ad spend − returns cost) ÷ actual revenue, from sales and cost records
metrics.source: SKU sales and cost table (brand sales data joined to sourcing cost records)
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days without a sales refresh
metrics.unavailable_when: SKU has under 20 units sold in the window
metrics.benchmark: compared directly against contribution_margin_pct_modelled for the same SKU

metrics.name: compliance_gate_status
metrics.plain: Whether the candidate's regulatory checks are cleared
metrics.formula: pass/fail flag from the compliance checklist attached to the margin gate (labelling, category-specific certification)
metrics.unavailable_when: compliance checklist not yet run
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a gate not a score

metrics.name: differentiation_angle_confidence
metrics.plain: How solid the stated point of difference is
metrics.formula: rule score from whether the angle field is filled, is backed by a named source (review gap, teardown or field research), and is not a copy of a competitor's own claim
metrics.unavailable_when: angle field is empty
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an internal check not a market score

metrics.name: shortlist_score
metrics.plain: A candidate's rank on the fixed scorecard
metrics.formula: weighted sum of the scorecard's fixed criteria (demand, margin, differentiation, compliance, cash timing), weights set once per brand
metrics.unavailable_when: candidate has not reached the shortlist stage
metrics.benchmark: ranked against other candidates in the same batch, not an absolute score

metrics.name: go_live_gate_pass_count
metrics.plain: How many of the 5 go-live gates a candidate has cleared
metrics.formula: count of passed gates (provable claim, owned difference, brand threshold, contribution margin, ad-cost ceiling) ÷ 5
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any linked cost or claim change
metrics.unavailable_when: gates not yet run
metrics.benchmark: 5 of 5 required before launch (internal rule)

metrics.name: tech_pack_status
metrics.plain: Whether a SKU has a current, versioned spec ready for sourcing
metrics.formula: flag from the tech pack table: current version has tolerances, BOM and packaging cost line filled
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any supplier-side change without a new version
metrics.unavailable_when: no tech pack started
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a readiness flag

metrics.name: candidate_pipeline_age_days
metrics.plain: How long a candidate has sat in the pipeline without a decision
metrics.formula: today minus the candidate's screen-in date
metrics.unavailable_when: candidate has already been decided (go or kill)
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged against the brand's own time-box rule

metrics.name: shortlist_review_date_status
metrics.plain: Whether a shortlisted candidate's scheduled review has come due
metrics.formula: today compared against the review date set on the go/no-go memo
metrics.unavailable_when: no review date was set
metrics.benchmark: not applicable

metrics.name: sku_revenue_share
metrics.plain: Share of category revenue this SKU brings in
metrics.formula: SKU revenue ÷ total category revenue, trailing window
metrics.unavailable_when: SKU not yet live or no sales table linked
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; used to prioritise line-extension planning

metrics.name: sku_return_rate
metrics.plain: Share of units sold that come back
metrics.formula: returned units ÷ shipped units for the SKU, trailing window
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 units shipped
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; compared against the brand's own average return rate

insights.name: demand screen failed
insights.rule: candidate fails 2 or more of the demand, competition or store-fit checks in the screen
insights.sentence: {candidate} failed {n} of the fast checks. Killing it now saves the research hours.

insights.name: single-source video spike
insights.rule: video_commerce_demand_signal shows exactly 1 platform or creator source over the window
insights.sentence: {candidate}'s demand comes from one clip on one platform. Treat it as unverified until a second source confirms it.

insights.name: real sustained ad spend found
insights.rule: ad_library_spend_signal counts 3 or more advertisers with an ad live past 90 days
insights.sentence: {n} advertisers have kept an ad live for {days}+ days on this idea. That is a real spend signal, not a trend.

insights.name: trend up, category full
insights.rule: trend_direction_score is positive and competitive_saturation_count is above the brand's set ceiling
insights.sentence: {category} is growing, but {n} sellers already compete in it. Room left is smaller than the trend line suggests.

insights.name: margin gate failed
insights.rule: contribution_margin_pct_modelled is below the brand's set minimum threshold
insights.sentence: {candidate}'s modelled margin is {pct}%, below the {threshold}% floor. It cannot move to sourcing spend without a price, cost or channel change.

insights.name: actual margin trailing the model
insights.rule: contribution_margin_pct_actual is more than 5 points below contribution_margin_pct_modelled for the same SKU
insights.sentence: {sku} is making {actual}% margin against a {modelled}% model. Recheck landed cost and ad spend allocation.

insights.name: review price gap
insights.rule: review_price_signal is more than 15% below the candidate's planned price
insights.sentence: Reviewers say they would pay around {price}, {pct}% below the planned price. Recheck positioning before funding.

insights.name: unresolved category complaint
insights.rule: review_complaint_rate for the top complaint exceeds 15% of mined reviews
insights.sentence: {pct}% of reviews on the category leader mention the same complaint: {complaint}. That is the gap to build the angle on.

insights.name: seasonal candidate with no cash plan
insights.rule: demand_pattern_tag is seasonal or gifting and no cash timing note is attached
insights.sentence: {candidate} is tagged seasonal, but no cash plan is attached for its spike window. It cannot reach the shortlist without one.

insights.name: differentiation angle missing
insights.rule: differentiation_angle_confidence is unavailable (angle field empty) while the candidate is past the screening stage
insights.sentence: {candidate} has no stated point of difference. It should not reach a funding gate without one.

insights.name: candidate stalled past its time box
insights.rule: candidate_pipeline_age_days exceeds the time box set for its current stage
insights.sentence: {candidate} has sat at this stage for {days} days, past its {budget}-day box. Decide or kill it.

insights.name: shortlist review due
insights.rule: shortlist_review_date_status shows today at or past the set review date
insights.sentence: {candidate}'s review date has arrived. Bring it back to the founder for a fresh decision.
insights.severity: medium, keeps decisions from going stale

insights.name: hero SKU with no line extension
insights.rule: a SKU's sku_revenue_share is in the top decile of its category and no next-SKU candidate is open in the pipeline
insights.sentence: {sku} drives {pct}% of category revenue with no next SKU in the pipeline. Consider planning an extension.

insights.name: compliance gate incomplete
insights.rule: compliance_gate_status is unavailable while go_live_gate_pass_count shows other gates passed
insights.sentence: {candidate} has cleared {n} of 5 gates but the compliance check has not run. It is not fundable yet.

metrics.name: stock_cover_days
metrics.plain: How many days of stock are left at current sales pace
metrics.formula: current stock units ÷ trailing 14-day average daily units sold
metrics.source: inventory table joined to SKU sales
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without an inventory sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no inventory feed connected for that channel
metrics.benchmark: compared against the SKU's own lead_time_days plus safety buffer, not an external number

metrics.name: reorder_point_units
metrics.plain: The stock level that should trigger a new order
metrics.formula: (average daily units sold × lead_time_days) + safety_stock_units
metrics.window: recalculated weekly or on a velocity or lead-time change
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 days of sales history for the SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; brand-specific by SKU

metrics.name: safety_stock_units
metrics.plain: Buffer stock held against demand spikes and delays
metrics.formula: service-level factor × demand standard deviation × sqrt(lead_time_days)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 days of sales history
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; service level is a brand setting

metrics.name: landed_cost_per_unit
metrics.plain: What one unit actually costs after freight, duty and FX
metrics.formula: base supplier cost + freight allocated per unit + duty + FX conversion at the rate on the invoice date
metrics.window: recomputed on any FX, freight or duty change, else weekly
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any linked FX or freight rate move of more than 3%
metrics.unavailable_when: no recent invoice or FX rate on file for the SKU
metrics.benchmark: compared against the price used in the SKU's margin gate, not an external number

metrics.name: supplier_concentration_share
metrics.plain: Share of purchase volume from the single largest supplier
metrics.formula: largest supplier's purchased units ÷ total purchased units, trailing 12 months
metrics.source: supplier master table joined to PO history
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 POs on file
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged internally above 60%

metrics.name: country_concentration_share
metrics.plain: Share of purchase volume from the single largest sourcing country
metrics.formula: largest country's purchased units ÷ total purchased units, trailing 12 months
metrics.source: supplier master table joined to PO history
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 POs on file
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged internally above 70%

metrics.name: supplier_scorecard_score
metrics.plain: A supplier's combined on-time, defect and price-stability score
metrics.formula: weighted score from on_time_delivery_pct, defect_rate_pct and price_change_frequency over the scoring period
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days without a new PO to score
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 completed POs with this supplier
metrics.benchmark: ranked against the brand's other suppliers, not an external index

metrics.name: fulfilment_sla_adherence_pct
metrics.plain: Share of orders the 3PL dispatched inside its promised time
metrics.formula: orders dispatched within contracted SLA window ÷ total orders processed
metrics.unavailable_when: no WMS or 3PL feed connected
metrics.benchmark: compared against the SLA written in the 3PL contract

metrics.name: courier_rto_rate
metrics.plain: Share of shipments a courier returns undelivered, by zone
metrics.formula: RTO shipments ÷ total shipments for that courier and zone
metrics.source: courier scorecard table (shipment and delivery status feed)
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 shipments for that courier-zone pair in the window
metrics.benchmark: compared across the brand's own couriers in the same zone, not an external figure

metrics.name: courier_first_attempt_delivery_rate
metrics.plain: Share of shipments delivered on the courier's first attempt
metrics.formula: shipments delivered on attempt 1 ÷ total delivered shipments, by courier and zone
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 shipments for that pair
metrics.benchmark: compared across the brand's own couriers, same zone

metrics.name: courier_delivery_tat_days
metrics.plain: Average days from dispatch to delivery, by courier and zone
metrics.formula: mean of (delivered_at − dispatched_at) in days, by courier and zone
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 shipments for that pair
metrics.benchmark: compared across the brand's own couriers, same zone

metrics.name: ndr_open_count
metrics.plain: How many non-delivery reports are open right now
metrics.formula: count of NDR records with status open, grouped by hours remaining in the attempt window
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 6 hours without a courier status sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no courier NDR feed connected
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an operational queue count

metrics.name: cod_remittance_variance
metrics.plain: Difference between what a courier should pay in COD and what it actually paid
metrics.formula: sum of expected COD amount per order − sum of amount actually remitted, by courier and period
metrics.source: COD remittance table joined to order records
metrics.freshness_rule: stale once a new remittance cycle closes without reconciliation
metrics.unavailable_when: remittance file not yet received from courier
metrics.benchmark: not applicable; any nonzero variance is a dispute candidate

metrics.name: dead_stock_value
metrics.plain: Value of stock that is old and barely moving
metrics.formula: units aged past the brand's dead-stock threshold × landed_cost_per_unit, summed by SKU
metrics.source: inventory age table joined to landed cost table
metrics.unavailable_when: no inventory age data for that SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; threshold set per brand and category

metrics.name: price_lock_days_remaining
metrics.plain: Days left before a supplier's price lock or contract expires
metrics.formula: contract renewal_date − today, in days
metrics.unavailable_when: no contract on file for that supplier
metrics.benchmark: not applicable

metrics.name: three_way_match_exception_count
metrics.plain: How many purchase orders have a quantity or price mismatch against the invoice and goods received
metrics.formula: count of PO-invoice-GRN triplets where quantity or unit price differs beyond a set tolerance
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days without a new match run
metrics.unavailable_when: goods receipt not yet logged for that PO
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an exception count

metrics.name: commodity_input_cost_index
metrics.plain: How the priced-in raw material behind a SKU is trending
metrics.formula: current commodity price ÷ price on the date the SKU's cost was last locked, indexed to 100
metrics.unavailable_when: no tracked commodity mapped to that SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; used to time a cost-down ask

metrics.name: peak_season_readiness_pct
metrics.plain: How ready stock, staffing and systems are for the next festive peak
metrics.formula: average of (safety stock vs peak target, warehouse staffing booked vs target, WMS/OMS load-test pass) as percentages
metrics.window: checked weekly in the 90 days before the festival date
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days inside the 90-day window
metrics.unavailable_when: no peak season plan created for the upcoming festival
metrics.benchmark: 100% readiness target set per brand ahead of the date

metrics.name: ndr_to_rto_conversion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of NDRs that end up going back as RTO instead of delivering
metrics.formula: orders that end in RTO after an NDR ÷ total orders that had at least one NDR, trailing period
metrics.source: NDR queue table joined to shipment outcome
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 NDR cases in the window
metrics.benchmark: compared against the brand's own trailing average, not an external figure

insights.name: reorder breach
insights.rule: stock_cover_days is less than lead_time_days plus the safety buffer for that SKU
insights.sentence: {sku} has {days} days of cover against a {lead} day lead time. Place the order now.

insights.name: landed cost drifted without a margin recheck
insights.rule: landed_cost_per_unit has moved more than 5% since the last margin gate run for that SKU, and the gate has not been rerun
insights.sentence: {sku}'s landed cost moved {pct}% since its margin was last checked. Rerun the gate before the next order.

insights.name: supplier concentration risk
insights.rule: supplier_concentration_share exceeds 60% with no backup supplier mapped in a second country
insights.sentence: {pct}% of {sku}'s volume comes from one supplier with no mapped backup. One factory problem stops this SKU.

insights.name: supplier scorecard slipping
insights.rule: supplier_scorecard_score falls for 2 consecutive scoring periods
insights.sentence: {supplier}'s scorecard has dropped for {n} periods in a row. Review before the next PO.

insights.name: courier underperforming a zone
insights.rule: courier_rto_rate for a courier-zone pair is more than 10 points above the brand's best courier in the same zone
insights.sentence: {courier} runs a {pct} RTO rate in {zone}, {diff} points worse than {best_courier}. Shift volume.

insights.name: NDR aging toward its attempt window
insights.rule: an open NDR has fewer than 4 hours left before the courier's attempt window closes
insights.sentence: {n} NDRs close their attempt window in under 4 hours. Confirm the address or reschedule now.

insights.name: COD remittance shortfall
insights.rule: cod_remittance_variance is nonzero for a closed remittance cycle
insights.sentence: {courier} remitted {amount} less than expected for {period}. Open a billing dispute.

insights.name: stock turning into dead weight
insights.rule: a SKU's inventory age passes the brand's dead-stock threshold while its sales velocity stays below the brand's slow-mover line
insights.sentence: {sku} has {units} units aged past {days} days with barely any sales. Draft a clearance plan.

insights.name: price lock expiring soon
insights.rule: price_lock_days_remaining is under 30 days with no renegotiation started
insights.sentence: {supplier}'s price lock ends in {days} days. Start the renewal conversation now.

insights.name: invoice does not match goods received
insights.rule: three_way_match_exception_count is greater than 0 for a PO ready to pay
insights.sentence: {po_id} has a quantity or price mismatch against what was received. Hold payment and check it.

insights.name: commodity cost spike
insights.rule: commodity_input_cost_index rises more than 8% since the SKU's cost was last locked
insights.sentence: The raw material behind {sku} is up {pct}% since the last price lock. Recheck margin before the next PO.

insights.name: peak season not ready
insights.rule: peak_season_readiness_pct is below 80% with fewer than 45 days left to the festival date
insights.sentence: Peak-season readiness is {pct}% with {days} days to go. Stock, staffing or systems need attention now.

insights.name: NDR converting to RTO more than usual
insights.rule: ndr_to_rto_conversion_rate rises more than 10 points above the brand's trailing 90-day average
insights.sentence: NDRs are converting to RTO {pct} more than usual this period. Check address-confirmation outreach and courier performance.

not_elsewhere.claim: combines safety stock, warehouse staffing and WMS load readiness against the festive calendar into one readiness percentage
not_elsewhere.vs: peak-season planning is normally a spreadsheet exercise split across ops, warehouse and sourcing with no single readiness number
