metrics.name: listing_health_score
metrics.plain: Share of live listings passing the channel's own content rules
metrics.formula: listings with no open image, attribute or content error ÷ total live listings, per channel
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 48 hours without a re-audit
metrics.unavailable_when: no catalogue feed connected for that channel
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; internally targeted at 100% per channel

metrics.name: image_video_spec_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of product images and videos meeting each channel's size and crop rules
metrics.formula: assets passing the channel's own spec check ÷ total assets checked, per channel
metrics.source: catalogue audit table, media spec checker
metrics.unavailable_when: no media spec checker run for that channel
metrics.benchmark: channel's own published spec, not a general standard

metrics.name: buy_box_win_rate
metrics.plain: Share of time this brand holds the Buy Box on its own listings
metrics.formula: time-weighted share of Buy Box ownership by the brand's own seller account ÷ total tracked time, per SKU
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 24 hours without a snapshot
metrics.unavailable_when: no Buy Box tracking connected for that SKU
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; any loss on an actively advertised SKU is flagged

metrics.name: reseller_price_variance
metrics.plain: How far an unauthorised reseller's price sits below MAP
metrics.formula: (MAP price − lowest tracked reseller price) ÷ MAP price, per SKU
metrics.source: Buy Box and reseller price snapshot table
metrics.unavailable_when: no reseller price tracked for that SKU
metrics.benchmark: brand's own MAP policy, not an external figure

metrics.name: account_health_score
metrics.plain: How close the seller account is to a policy or performance suspension risk
metrics.formula: channel's own account health metrics (order defect rate, policy strikes, late shipment rate) rolled into a single risk flag against the channel's stated suspension thresholds
metrics.window: trailing 30 to 90 days per channel's own window
metrics.unavailable_when: no account health feed connected for that channel
metrics.benchmark: the channel's own published suspension threshold

metrics.name: review_rating_avg
metrics.plain: Average star rating per SKU per channel
metrics.formula: mean of star ratings on live reviews, per SKU per channel
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 reviews on that SKU-channel pair
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; compared against the brand's own other SKUs on the same channel

metrics.name: catalogue_feed_freshness_hours
metrics.plain: How long since the shared catalogue feed last synced
metrics.formula: now − last successful feed sync timestamp
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 24 hours without a sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no feed pipeline configured
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an operational freshness check

metrics.name: quick_commerce_reported_roas
metrics.plain: The ROAS the platform's own dashboard shows
metrics.formula: platform-reported ad revenue ÷ platform-reported ad spend, as the platform calculates it (often on MRP)
metrics.unavailable_when: no ad dashboard export for that platform
metrics.benchmark: platform's own stated benchmark range, shown alongside the corrected figure

metrics.name: quick_commerce_true_roas
metrics.plain: ROAS recalculated from actual transaction value, not MRP
metrics.formula: sum of actual transaction value on attributed orders ÷ ad spend, using the real selling price after platform discount
metrics.source: quick commerce orders table joined to ad spend export
metrics.unavailable_when: transaction-level order value not available from the platform export
metrics.benchmark: compared directly against quick_commerce_reported_roas for the same period

metrics.name: settlement_variance_amount
metrics.plain: Difference between what a marketplace should pay out and what it actually paid
metrics.formula: sum of expected settlement value from order records − actual amount received, per platform per period
metrics.source: settlement reports joined to order records
metrics.freshness_rule: stale once a new cycle closes without reconciliation
metrics.unavailable_when: settlement report not yet received from the platform
metrics.benchmark: not applicable; any nonzero variance is a dispute candidate

metrics.name: dark_store_fill_rate_pct
metrics.plain: Share of dark stores carrying this SKU in stock right now
metrics.formula: dark stores with stock greater than zero for the SKU ÷ total dark stores expected to carry it
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 24 hours without a feed sync
metrics.unavailable_when: no dark store inventory feed connected for that platform
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; internally targeted near 100% for hero SKUs

metrics.name: ad_credit_utilization_pct
metrics.plain: Share of a platform's ad credit used before it expires
metrics.formula: ad credit spent ÷ ad credit granted, for the current credit cycle
metrics.unavailable_when: no ad credit ledger available for that platform
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, tracked against the cycle's own expiry date

metrics.name: amazon_ipi_score
metrics.plain: Amazon's Inventory Performance Index score
metrics.formula: value as reported by Amazon Seller Central
metrics.unavailable_when: no Amazon inventory export connected
metrics.benchmark: Amazon's own published storage-limit thresholds by score band

metrics.name: amazon_replenishment_alert_count
metrics.plain: How many FBA SKUs are below their recommended replenishment level
metrics.formula: count of SKUs where FBA sellable stock is below the recommended reorder trigger from cover targets
metrics.source: Amazon inventory table joined to reorder calc
metrics.unavailable_when: no Amazon inventory feed connected
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, an operational alert count

metrics.name: sales_change_attribution
metrics.plain: Whether an Amazon sales change is a traffic problem or a conversion problem
metrics.formula: split of the sales change into the portion explained by session/impression change versus the portion explained by conversion rate change, holding the other constant
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 100 sessions in either window
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a diagnostic split

metrics.name: listing_staleness_days
metrics.plain: Days since a Flipkart, Myntra or Nykaa listing was last updated
metrics.formula: today − last_updated_at, per listing
metrics.unavailable_when: listing not yet tracked in the audit table
metrics.benchmark: no external benchmark; flagged internally past 90 days

metrics.name: bis_compliance_status
metrics.plain: Whether a regulated SKU's BIS, hallmarking or labelling documentation is on file and current
metrics.formula: flag from the compliance docs table: required doc types present and not expired
metrics.unavailable_when: no compliance doc type mapped for that SKU's category
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, a legal gate

insights.name: listing failing channel spec
insights.rule: listing_health_score for a channel drops below 95%, or any single listing has an open image or attribute error
insights.sentence: {n} listings on {channel} fail a content or image rule right now. Fix before the next sync.
insights.severity: medium, blocks visibility or ads eligibility

insights.name: Buy Box lost on an advertised SKU
insights.rule: buy_box_win_rate falls below 80% for a SKU that is currently running ads
insights.sentence: {sku} is only winning the Buy Box {pct}% of the time while ads are live. Ad spend is funding someone else's sale.

insights.name: MAP violation detected
insights.rule: reseller_price_variance shows a tracked reseller price more than 10% below MAP
insights.sentence: A reseller is selling {sku} {pct}% below MAP. Flag it before it drags down price perception everywhere.

insights.name: account health approaching suspension risk
insights.rule: account_health_score crosses the channel's own stated warning threshold
insights.sentence: {channel} account health has crossed its warning line. Address it before it becomes a suspension.

insights.name: true ROAS far below what the dashboard shows
insights.rule: quick_commerce_reported_roas exceeds quick_commerce_true_roas by more than 20%
insights.sentence: {platform} shows {reported}x ROAS, but the real number on transaction value is {true}x. Do not scale spend on the reported figure.

insights.name: settlement shortfall
insights.rule: settlement_variance_amount is nonzero and beyond a small rounding tolerance for a closed cycle
insights.sentence: {platform} paid {amount} less than the order records show for {period}. Send to Finance to dispute.

insights.name: dark store stockout risk
insights.rule: dark_store_fill_rate_pct for a hero SKU falls below 70% for 2 consecutive days
insights.sentence: {sku} is out of stock in {pct}% of its dark stores for {n} days running. Expect a ranking penalty.

insights.name: ad credit going unused
insights.rule: ad_credit_utilization_pct is below 50% with fewer than 10 days left in the credit cycle
insights.sentence: {platform} ad credit is {pct}% used with {days} days left in the cycle. Spend it or lose it.

insights.name: IPI score risking storage limits
insights.rule: amazon_ipi_score falls below Amazon's published storage-limit threshold
insights.sentence: Amazon IPI score is {score}, below the storage-limit line. Storage capacity may be restricted.

insights.name: sales drop is a conversion problem, not traffic
insights.rule: sales_change_attribution shows over 70% of a sales drop explained by conversion rate, with traffic flat or up
insights.sentence: Sales fell {pct}%, but traffic held steady. The problem is on the listing or price, not visibility.

insights.name: stale marketplace listing
insights.rule: listing_staleness_days exceeds 90 for a listing on Flipkart, Myntra or Nykaa
insights.sentence: {sku} on {channel} has not been updated in {days} days. Review it against current competitor listings.

insights.name: compliance document missing before go-live
insights.rule: bis_compliance_status is unavailable or expired for a SKU category that requires it, and the listing is live or scheduled
insights.sentence: {sku} needs a current BIS or hallmarking document before it can stay live. It is missing or expired.

insights.name: catalogue feed gone stale
insights.rule: catalogue_feed_freshness_hours exceeds 24 while ads or listings depend on it
insights.sentence: The shared catalogue feed has not synced in {hours} hours. Ads and listings may be running on old data.

visuals.name: Buy Box ownership timeline

visuals.why_this_chart: shows when and how often the Buy Box was lost, not just today's snapshot

visuals.name: listing health scorecard grid

visuals.name: dark store fill rate map
visuals.shows: fill rate by store or region for each hero SKU
visuals.why_this_chart: shows exactly where a stockout is forming before it triggers a ranking penalty

visuals.name: account health gauge

metrics.name: cm1_per_order
metrics.plain: What is left after the product and payment fees
metrics.formula: net revenue − COGS − payment processing fees, per order
metrics.source: orders table + landed cost table + processor fee schedule
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 26 hours (one missed daily sync)
metrics.unavailable_when: landed cost missing for a SKU in the order
metrics.benchmark: no fixed benchmark; track trend against the brand's own history

metrics.name: cm2_per_order
metrics.plain: What is left after also paying to pack and ship it
metrics.formula: CM1 − fulfillment, shipping and packaging cost, per order
metrics.unavailable_when: fulfillment cost not mapped for the order's courier or weight band
metrics.benchmark: no fixed benchmark

metrics.name: cm3_per_channel
metrics.plain: What is left after also paying the marketing that brought the order in
metrics.formula: CM2 − variable marketing spend attributed to that order's channel (spend allocated pro rata by attributed orders)
metrics.source: orders table + ad_spend table (Meta MCP, Google Ads)
metrics.unavailable_when: spend not yet closed for the period, or order has no attributed channel
metrics.benchmark: no fixed benchmark; compare channel to channel

metrics.name: net_profit
metrics.plain: What the brand actually kept, bottom of the P&L ladder
metrics.formula: gross revenue − COGS − delivery cost − marketing cost − OPEX
metrics.source: P&L cost classification map + bank ledger
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after books close plus 5 days
metrics.unavailable_when: any P&L line still unclassified for the month
metrics.benchmark: no fixed benchmark

metrics.name: gross_margin_pct
metrics.plain: Percent kept after just product cost
metrics.formula: (net revenue − COGS) ÷ net revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: landed cost missing for over 5% of SKUs sold
metrics.benchmark: varies by category; track trend, not a fixed number

metrics.name: cash_low_point_13wk
metrics.plain: The lowest the bank balance is expected to go in the next 13 weeks, and when
metrics.formula: rolling 13-week cash forecast from current balance plus modeled inflows and outflows, minimum point
metrics.source: bank ledger + AP/AR + payroll + inventory PO schedule
metrics.unavailable_when: bank ledger not synced this week
metrics.benchmark: must stay above the brand's own minimum operating cash floor

metrics.name: days_inventory_outstanding
metrics.plain: How many days of stock sit in the warehouse on average
metrics.formula: average inventory value ÷ (COGS ÷ days in period) × days in period
metrics.unavailable_when: inventory count not reconciled this month
metrics.benchmark: target set against supplier lead time, not a universal number

metrics.name: cash_conversion_cycle
metrics.plain: Days between paying for stock and collecting cash for it
metrics.formula: days inventory outstanding + days sales outstanding − days payable outstanding
metrics.unavailable_when: any of the three inputs missing
metrics.benchmark: lower is better; compare to the brand's own history

metrics.name: cac_blended
metrics.plain: Total cost to get one new customer, all channels included
metrics.formula: total marketing spend ÷ new customers acquired, same period
metrics.source: ad_spend table + orders table (first-time customer flag)
metrics.unavailable_when: spend not closed or new-customer flag missing
metrics.benchmark: compare to CAC payback and LTGP:CAC bands, not a fixed number

metrics.name: cac_payback_months
metrics.plain: Months of gross profit it takes to earn back what it cost to get a customer
metrics.formula: CAC ÷ average monthly gross profit per new customer, from real cohorts
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after cohort is 60 days incomplete
metrics.unavailable_when: cohort has fewer than 30 customers
metrics.benchmark: under 12 months is a common e-commerce band; the brand's own cash conversion cycle is the harder limit

metrics.name: ltgp_to_cac
metrics.plain: Lifetime gross profit for every rupee spent to acquire
metrics.formula: lifetime gross profit per customer (fixed lookback window) ÷ CAC
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 90 days without a cohort refresh
metrics.unavailable_when: cohort window not yet elapsed
metrics.benchmark: 3:1 or better is a common floor; the brand sets its own band

metrics.name: mer_and_amer
metrics.plain: Total revenue for every rupee of ad spend, plain and adjusted
metrics.formula: MER = total revenue ÷ total ad spend; aMER = (total revenue − discount-code and branded-search revenue) ÷ total ad spend
metrics.source: orders table + ad_spend table + discount code table
metrics.unavailable_when: discount code attribution missing (aMER only)
metrics.benchmark: no fixed benchmark; compare to the brand's own trend

metrics.name: landed_cost_per_sku
metrics.plain: The full cost to get one unit into a box, ready to sell
metrics.formula: product cost + freight + duty + packaging, per SKU
metrics.source: supplier invoices + freight bills + duty schedule
metrics.window: refreshed on supplier or volume change
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 90 days without a check
metrics.unavailable_when: no backup document on file for a cost line
metrics.benchmark: no fixed benchmark

metrics.name: platform_books_variance
metrics.plain: How far Shopify, Meta, GA4, the processor and the books disagree
metrics.formula: for each of the 5 recurring gaps: |platform figure − books figure| and named cause
metrics.source: Shopify, Meta MCP, GA4, payment processor, accounting export
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after books close plus 10 days
metrics.unavailable_when: any of the 5 sources has not closed the month
metrics.benchmark: target under 1% variance per gap

metrics.name: cod_remittance_gap
metrics.plain: COD cash collected but not yet in the bank
metrics.formula: sum of COD collected by courier − sum remitted, aged by days since collection
metrics.unavailable_when: a courier has not sent its collection report
metrics.benchmark: target: fully remitted within the courier's stated SLA

metrics.name: gst_liability_position
metrics.plain: What is owed or claimable in GST this period
metrics.formula: output GST on sales − input GST credit, by state/GSTIN
metrics.unavailable_when: a state's sales crossed the registration threshold with no GSTIN on file
metrics.benchmark: must reconcile to the filed return within the accountant's tolerance

metrics.name: opex_vs_budget
metrics.plain: Overspend or underspend against the annual plan, by category
metrics.formula: (actual OPEX − budgeted OPEX) ÷ budgeted OPEX, per category, per month
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after books close plus 5 days
metrics.unavailable_when: category not mapped in the budget
metrics.benchmark: flag anything over 10% off budget

metrics.name: subscription_churn_rate
metrics.plain: Share of subscribers who left this period, against the right base
metrics.formula: customers who canceled in period ÷ active subscribers at the start of the period
metrics.unavailable_when: subscriber base not synced this month
metrics.benchmark: compare to the brand's own trailing 3-month average, not an industry number

insights.name: margin leak by SKU
insights.rule: a SKU's unit volume rose over the trailing 3 months while its CM3 stayed negative
insights.sentence: {sku} sold more each month but still loses ₹{amount} per unit after marketing cost
insights.severity: high if CM3 is negative and worsening, else medium

insights.name: cash below floor
insights.rule: the 13-week forecast's lowest point falls below the brand's stated minimum cash floor
insights.sentence: cash is projected to fall below ₹{floor} in week {n} if nothing changes

insights.name: promo missed break-even
insights.rule: a completed promo's realized margin is below the break-even margin modeled before it launched
insights.sentence: {promo} needed a {x}% sales lift to break even and got {y}%

insights.name: CAC payback outruns cash cycle
insights.rule: CAC payback period in months exceeds the cash conversion cycle expressed in months
insights.sentence: new customers take {x} months to pay back but cash is tied up for {y} months first

insights.name: platform-books gap unexplained
insights.rule: platform_books_variance exceeds 2% for a source with no cause tagged
insights.sentence: {source} and the books differ by ₹{amount} this month with no named cause

insights.name: COD remittance stuck
insights.rule: cod_remittance_gap for a courier exceeds that courier's stated SLA in days
insights.sentence: ₹{amount} in COD cash from {courier} is {n} days past its remittance SLA

insights.name: inventory cash overhang
insights.rule: days_inventory_outstanding exceeds the SKU's supplier lead time by more than 30 days
insights.sentence: ₹{amount} of {sku} stock sits {n} days beyond what lead time needs

insights.name: subscription churn spike
insights.rule: subscription_churn_rate this month exceeds the trailing 3-month average by 20% relative
insights.sentence: {x}% more subscribers churned this month than the 3-month average

insights.name: budget overrun
insights.rule: opex_vs_budget for a category exceeds 10% over budget
insights.sentence: {category} spent {x}% over budget this month

insights.name: GST exposure
insights.rule: a state or marketplace's trailing 12-month sales crossed the registration threshold with no matching GSTIN on file
insights.sentence: {market} sales crossed the GST registration threshold with no registration logged

metrics.name: ga4_audit_score
metrics.plain: How many GA4 setup checks pass
metrics.formula: checks passed ÷ total checks run (property structure, timezone, retention, consent, key events, ecommerce parameters)
metrics.unavailable_when: GA4 property not connected
metrics.benchmark: target 100% pass on critical checks

metrics.name: capi_match_quality
metrics.plain: How well Meta can match a purchase event to a real person
metrics.formula: event match quality score as reported by Meta events manager, per event type
metrics.unavailable_when: CAPI not connected for that event
metrics.benchmark: Meta's own good/needs-improvement bands

metrics.name: event_dedup_rate
metrics.plain: Share of events counted twice, once from the browser and once from the server
metrics.formula: duplicate event_id matches ÷ total events sent, browser plus CAPI
metrics.unavailable_when: event_id not present on one side
metrics.benchmark: target under 2%

metrics.name: utm_compliance_rate
metrics.plain: Share of paid clicks that arrive with a valid, convention-following UTM
metrics.formula: sessions with a valid utm_source/medium/campaign per the brand's convention ÷ total paid sessions
metrics.source: GA4 session data + UTM convention doc
metrics.unavailable_when: campaign not yet mapped to the convention
metrics.benchmark: target 100% on active paid campaigns

metrics.name: fake_direct_share
metrics.plain: Share of sessions wrongly counted as direct or organic
metrics.formula: sessions matching a known paid-link pattern but landing with no UTM ÷ total direct+organic sessions
metrics.unavailable_when: no campaign log to compare against
metrics.benchmark: target under 5%

metrics.name: attribution_model_gap
metrics.plain: How far last-click and data-driven attribution disagree, by channel
metrics.formula: |last-click attributed revenue − data-driven attributed revenue| ÷ data-driven attributed revenue, per channel
metrics.unavailable_when: a model is not available for that channel
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; flag widening gaps

metrics.name: incrementality_lift
metrics.plain: How much of a channel's reported sales actually happened because of it
metrics.formula: holdout or geo-lift test result: (test group revenue − control group revenue) ÷ control group revenue
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 180 days without a new test
metrics.unavailable_when: no test has been run for that channel
metrics.benchmark: compare to the channel's platform-reported ROAS

metrics.name: order_count_variance
metrics.plain: How far GA4, Meta, Shopify and marketplaces disagree on order count
metrics.formula: |platform order count − Shopify order count| ÷ Shopify order count, per platform, per day
metrics.source: GA4 + Meta MCP + Shopify + marketplace exports
metrics.unavailable_when: a platform has not reported for that day
metrics.benchmark: target under 3% variance

metrics.name: bot_traffic_share
metrics.plain: Share of sessions that look like bots, not buyers
metrics.formula: sessions flagged by bot-score threshold ÷ total sessions
metrics.unavailable_when: no bot-scoring source connected
metrics.benchmark: flag anything above the brand's own trailing baseline

metrics.name: daily_trust_score
metrics.plain: A pass, warn or fail grade for yesterday's data before anyone reads it
metrics.formula: rule-based score across freshness, reconciliation variance and known-bad patterns for every connected source
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than half of connected sources reported
metrics.benchmark: pass required before yesterday's numbers are read

metrics.name: funnel_step_conversion
metrics.plain: Percent of visitors who move to the next funnel step
metrics.formula: sessions reaching a step ÷ sessions reaching the step before it, for session→PDP→cart→checkout→purchase
metrics.unavailable_when: a step's event is not firing
metrics.benchmark: compared to the brand's own trailing 90-day average, never an industry number

metrics.name: metric_definition_drift
metrics.plain: How many numbers have more than one definition in active use
metrics.formula: count of metric names with 2 or more distinct stored formulas in the metric contract
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days without a review
metrics.unavailable_when: metric contract not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target zero

metrics.name: source_freshness_lag
metrics.plain: How many hours since a connected source last synced
metrics.formula: current time − last_sync_at, per source
metrics.freshness_rule: a source is stale once its own expected cadence is missed
metrics.unavailable_when: no heartbeat recorded for that source
metrics.benchmark: each source's own stated cadence

metrics.name: rfm_segment_migration
metrics.plain: How many customers moved segment this period
metrics.formula: count of customer_id whose RFM segment label changed between this period and last
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 periods of history exist
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; watch Loyal-to-At-Risk moves

metrics.name: mmm_vs_platform_gap
metrics.plain: How far the modeled channel contribution differs from what the platform claims
metrics.formula: |modeled_contribution − platform_reported| ÷ platform_reported, per channel
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 45 days without a model refresh
metrics.unavailable_when: under 6 months of history for that channel
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; large or growing gaps get flagged

metrics.name: tag_duplicate_fire_rate
metrics.plain: Share of page loads where a tag fires more than once
metrics.formula: duplicate tag fires ÷ total tag fires, per container
metrics.source: tag manager debug log / server-side container log
metrics.unavailable_when: container not instrumented for duplicate detection
metrics.benchmark: target under 1%

insights.name: GA4 tracking gap

metrics.name: sop_coverage_rate
metrics.plain: Share of core roles with a current, written SOP
metrics.formula: roles with an SOP reviewed in the last 6 months ÷ total core roles
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 35 days without a check
metrics.unavailable_when: sop_register not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target 100% for core silos

metrics.name: time_to_fill
metrics.plain: Days between a hiring trigger firing and an offer accepted
metrics.formula: offer_accepted_date − trigger_crossed_date, per role
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after the role is filled and not updated within 5 days
metrics.unavailable_when: trigger not logged for that role
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; compare across the brand's own searches

metrics.name: decision_log_completeness
metrics.plain: Share of high-stakes decisions logged with an owner and a review date
metrics.formula: decisions logged with owner + metric + review date ÷ decisions the framework says should be logged
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 35 days without an entry check
metrics.unavailable_when: decision_log not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

metrics.name: vendor_sla_hit_rate
metrics.plain: Share of a vendor's SLA terms actually met
metrics.formula: SLA metrics hit ÷ SLA metrics measured, per vendor, per period
metrics.unavailable_when: vendor has no written SLA on file
metrics.benchmark: target 100% against the written SLA

metrics.name: invoice_sla_match_rate
metrics.plain: Share of vendor invoices that match the agreed SLA and rate card
metrics.formula: invoices matching contracted rate and SLA ÷ total invoices audited
metrics.unavailable_when: invoice not itemized enough to check
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

metrics.name: cs_cost_per_ticket
metrics.plain: What one support ticket costs on average
metrics.formula: total CS cost in period ÷ tickets resolved in period
metrics.unavailable_when: CS cost not allocated for the period
metrics.benchmark: compare to the brand's own trailing average

metrics.name: cs_resolution_time
metrics.plain: Median time to resolve a ticket
metrics.formula: median(resolved_at − opened_at), by complexity tier
metrics.unavailable_when: complexity not tagged
metrics.benchmark: compare to the brand's own trailing average, by tier

metrics.name: tooling_spend_pct_revenue
metrics.plain: Software spend as a share of revenue
metrics.formula: total tooling spend in period ÷ net revenue in period
metrics.unavailable_when: a tool's cost is not tagged
metrics.benchmark: compare to the brand's own revenue-stage plan, not a universal number

metrics.name: meeting_cadence_adherence
metrics.plain: Share of scheduled trading reviews and check-ins that actually happened
metrics.formula: meetings held ÷ meetings scheduled, by type
metrics.unavailable_when: meeting_log not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target 100% for the weekly trading review

metrics.name: freelancer_completion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of contractor engagements with scope, IP assignment and on-time invoicing all in place
metrics.formula: engagements with all 3 items checked ÷ total active engagements
metrics.unavailable_when: engagement not logged
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

metrics.name: contract_redline_turnaround
metrics.plain: Days to get an incoming contract redlined and returned
metrics.formula: returned_date − received_date, per contract
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 14 days on an open contract
metrics.unavailable_when: contract not logged
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; flag anything over 10 business days

metrics.name: offboarding_completion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of exits with same-day access revocation and a completed checklist
metrics.formula: exits with access revoked same day and checklist complete ÷ total exits
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 5 days on an open exit
metrics.unavailable_when: exit not logged
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

metrics.name: saas_renewal_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of upcoming SaaS renewals with a usage review done before the window closes
metrics.formula: renewals with a usage review logged before auto-renew date ÷ renewals due in the next 60 days
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 35 days without a check
metrics.unavailable_when: contract renewal date not on file
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

metrics.name: handbook_acknowledgment_rate
metrics.plain: Share of staff who have signed the current handbook version
metrics.formula: staff with a signed acknowledgment of the current version ÷ total staff
metrics.window: on every handbook update, then monthly
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 35 days after a version change
metrics.unavailable_when: hr_records not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

insights.name: SOP gap
insights.rule: a core role in the silo map has no SOP entry, or its SOP is over 6 months old
insights.sentence: {role} has no current written SOP

insights.name: hiring trigger crossed

insights.sentence: {silo} crossed its hiring trigger {n} weeks ago with no req open

insights.name: vendor SLA breach
insights.rule: vendor_sla_hit_rate for a vendor falls below 90% in the period
insights.sentence: {vendor} missed its {sla_metric} SLA {n} times this month

insights.name: decision log gap
insights.rule: no new entry was added to the decision log in the same period the weekly review meeting was held
insights.sentence: no decision was logged in {n} weeks despite the weekly review happening

insights.name: CS cost drift
insights.rule: cs_cost_per_ticket this period exceeds the trailing 90-day average by more than 15%
insights.sentence: cost per ticket rose {pct} versus the last quarter

insights.name: tooling misfit

insights.sentence: {tool} costs {pct} of revenue, above what the brand's stage plan allows

insights.name: offboarding gap
insights.rule: offboarding_completion_rate shows an exited employee with access still active past the same day
insights.sentence: {n} accounts stayed active after {employee} left

insights.name: SaaS renewal window closing

insights.sentence: {tool} renews in {n} days and nobody has reviewed its usage yet

metrics.name: open_findings_by_severity
metrics.plain: How many security issues are open right now, by how bad they are
metrics.formula: count of findings with resolved_at empty, grouped by severity
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 9 days without a new scan
metrics.unavailable_when: no scan run this week
metrics.benchmark: target zero critical findings open past their fix window

metrics.name: finding_age_days
metrics.plain: How long an open finding has been sitting unresolved
metrics.formula: today − opened_at, per open finding
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 9 days without a scan
metrics.unavailable_when: finding has no opened_at
metrics.benchmark: critical findings should close within 7 days

metrics.name: bot_traffic_pct
metrics.plain: Share of site traffic that scores as automated
metrics.formula: requests below the bot-score threshold ÷ total requests, by endpoint
metrics.unavailable_when: bot scoring not enabled
metrics.benchmark: flag anything above the brand's own trailing baseline, especially on checkout

metrics.name: card_testing_bursts
metrics.plain: Number of times card attempts spiked in a short window, a known fraud pattern
metrics.formula: count of time windows where failed-auth attempts exceed the set per-minute threshold
metrics.unavailable_when: processor does not expose attempt-level logs
metrics.benchmark: target zero unhandled bursts

metrics.name: chargeback_rate
metrics.plain: Share of orders disputed as chargebacks
metrics.formula: chargebacks in period ÷ orders in period
metrics.unavailable_when: processor has not closed the period
metrics.benchmark: kept below the processor's own flag threshold, with headroom

metrics.name: false_decline_rate
metrics.plain: Share of good orders wrongly blocked by fraud rules
metrics.formula: declined orders later confirmed legitimate ÷ total declined orders
metrics.unavailable_when: declines not reviewed
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; track against approval-rate trend

metrics.name: admin_2fa_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of admin accounts with 2FA or a passkey enabled
metrics.formula: admin accounts with 2FA/passkey enabled ÷ total admin accounts
metrics.unavailable_when: a platform's admin list not pulled this week
metrics.benchmark: target 100%

metrics.name: access_review_completeness
metrics.plain: Share of staff mapped to a least-privilege role with a recent review
metrics.formula: staff with a role review in the last 90 days ÷ total staff with admin access
metrics.unavailable_when: no review logged
metrics.benchmark: target 100% every quarter

metrics.name: backup_restore_success
metrics.plain: Whether the last restore test actually worked, and when it ran
metrics.formula: most recent backup_log row with restore_tested_at set, and its result
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 35 days without a restore test
metrics.unavailable_when: no restore test on file
metrics.benchmark: target: a successful restore test at least every 30 days

metrics.name: dns_dangling_records
metrics.plain: Number of DNS records pointing at something that no longer exists
metrics.formula: count of dns_records with status = dangling
metrics.unavailable_when: DNS not scanned this week
metrics.benchmark: target zero

metrics.name: lookalike_domain_count
metrics.plain: Number of new domains that could be impersonating the brand
metrics.formula: count of domain_watch rows registered in the period matching the brand's name pattern
metrics.unavailable_when: brand monitoring not running
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; every new one gets reviewed

metrics.name: email_auth_status
metrics.plain: Whether email from this domain can be spoofed
metrics.formula: SPF present, DKIM present, DMARC policy (none/quarantine/reject), per sending domain
metrics.unavailable_when: domain not checked this week
metrics.benchmark: target DMARC at reject on every sending domain

metrics.name: credential_rotation_overdue
metrics.plain: Number of API keys or tokens overdue for rotation
metrics.formula: count of credential_inventory rows where today − last_rotated exceeds the set rotation schedule
metrics.unavailable_when: inventory not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target zero overdue

metrics.name: pci_saq_status
metrics.plain: Which PCI self-assessment applies, and when it was last confirmed
metrics.formula: current saq_type and days since confirmed_at, per payment flow
metrics.unavailable_when: no assessment on file
metrics.benchmark: must be reconfirmed at least yearly or on any checkout change

metrics.name: phishing_sim_click_rate
metrics.plain: Share of staff who clicked the last simulated phishing email
metrics.formula: staff who clicked ÷ staff who received the simulation
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 100 days without a new simulation
metrics.unavailable_when: no simulation run
metrics.benchmark: target under 5%, trending down

metrics.name: vendor_risk_completion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of vendors with a completed risk check and signed data-processing agreement before data access
metrics.formula: vendors with questionnaire complete and DPA signed before data_access_granted_at ÷ total vendors with data access
metrics.window: on every new vendor, reviewed quarterly
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 100 days without a review
metrics.unavailable_when: vendor_risk not maintained
metrics.benchmark: target 100% before access is granted

insights.name: critical finding aging
insights.rule: a finding with severity critical has finding_age_days over 7
insights.sentence: {finding} has been open {n} days past the 7-day fix window

insights.name: checkout bot surge

insights.sentence: {pct}% of checkout traffic this week scored as bots, up from {baseline_pct}%

insights.name: card testing detected
insights.rule: card_testing_bursts is above zero in the period
insights.sentence: {n} failed card attempts hit checkout in {window}, a card-testing pattern

insights.name: chargeback rate rising toward flag
insights.rule: chargeback_rate is within 0.2 points of the processor's own flag threshold
insights.sentence: chargebacks are at {pct}, {gap} points under the processor's flag line

insights.name: admin missing 2FA
insights.rule: admin_2fa_coverage is below 100%
insights.sentence: {n} admin accounts have no 2FA or passkey

insights.name: backup restore untested
insights.rule: days since the last successful backup_restore_success exceeds 30
insights.sentence: the last successful restore test was {n} days ago

insights.name: dangling DNS record
insights.rule: dns_dangling_records is above zero
insights.sentence: {n} DNS records point at nothing and could be hijacked

insights.name: lookalike domain registered
insights.rule: lookalike_domain_count is above zero in the period
insights.sentence: {n} new lookalike domains were registered this month

insights.name: DMARC not enforcing
insights.rule: email_auth_status shows dmarc policy as none or quarantine on a sending domain
insights.sentence: DMARC on {domain} is not set to reject, so spoofed mail is not blocked

insights.name: credential overdue
insights.rule: credential_rotation_overdue is above zero
insights.sentence: {n} API keys have not been rotated in over {days} days

insights.name: return abuse pattern
insights.rule: a customer's return_count_90d exceeds the brand's own set threshold for orders in the same window
insights.sentence: {customer} has returned {n} of their last {m} orders

insights.name: vendor risk gap

not_elsewhere.vs: each platform has its own login and access logs; no single connected tool compares login geography and device across all of them to catch a pattern that only shows up together

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows every card (findings, bot traffic, access, backups, domain risk) as unavailable with the exact scan or feed missing, never a false all-clear. The first thing it shows once one scan and the admin access list land is open findings by severity and 2FA coverage; bot, backup, DNS and credential cards light up as those feeds are added.

metrics.name: avatar_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of last 90 days' revenue tied to a gated, complete avatar record
metrics.formula: revenue from orders matched to a primary or segmented avatar / total revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: no avatar record is gated yet
metrics.benchmark: not applicable, track against the brand's own trend

metrics.name: avatar_evidence_count
metrics.plain: How many independent quotes back each avatar's job statement
metrics.formula: count of distinct sourced quotes per avatar record
metrics.unavailable_when: avatar has zero quotes, shown as provisional

metrics.name: avatar_freshness_days
metrics.plain: Days since this avatar was last re-checked against real orders and reviews
metrics.formula: today minus last audit date
metrics.unavailable_when: avatar has never been audited
metrics.benchmark: flag over 90 days

metrics.name: language_bank_size
metrics.plain: Exact customer phrases on file per avatar
metrics.formula: count of tracked phrases per avatar, deduplicated
metrics.unavailable_when: no phrases logged yet

metrics.name: language_bank_reuse_rate
metrics.plain: Share of live ad, page and email lines that trace back to a banked customer phrase
metrics.formula: lines matched to a bank phrase / total scored lines
metrics.source: language bank x live copy scan
metrics.unavailable_when: no live copy scan has run

metrics.name: voice_compliance_score
metrics.plain: Share of live assets that pass the voice sheet check
metrics.formula: assets passing / assets scanned, across site, ads and email
metrics.unavailable_when: no voice sheet exists yet
metrics.benchmark: flag under 90 percent

metrics.name: voice_drift_flags
metrics.plain: New drift issues found this audit that were not flagged last time
metrics.formula: count of new rule violations this run
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 audits exist

metrics.name: claims_risk_count
metrics.plain: Claims waiting on evidence or legal review before they can ship
metrics.formula: count of claims in the registry without a passed evidence tier
metrics.unavailable_when: claims registry is empty

metrics.name: branded_search_index
metrics.plain: How often people search for the brand by name, indexed to a base month
metrics.formula: branded query volume / volume in the base month, times 100
metrics.source: search console or a connected search tool
metrics.unavailable_when: no search connector attached
metrics.benchmark: rising is healthy at flat or growing spend

metrics.name: mention_volume
metrics.plain: Public mentions of the brand across tracked sources
metrics.formula: count of mentions per period
metrics.unavailable_when: no listening connector attached

metrics.name: mention_sentiment_net
metrics.plain: Share of mentions reading positive minus share reading negative
metrics.formula: (positive mentions minus negative mentions) / total mentions
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 20 mentions in the period
metrics.benchmark: flag when net turns negative

metrics.name: repeat_purchase_rate
metrics.plain: Share of customers in the window who bought again
metrics.formula: customers with 2 or more orders / customers with 1 or more orders
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 first-time customers in the window

metrics.name: review_rating_trend
metrics.plain: Average star rating over time
metrics.formula: mean rating per period, all verified reviews
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 10 reviews in the period

metrics.name: objection_coverage
metrics.plain: Share of named objections that have a proven remover attached
metrics.formula: objections with a paired remover / total named objections
metrics.unavailable_when: objection map is empty

metrics.name: mystery_shopper_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of journey checkpoints that passed on the last run
metrics.formula: checkpoints passed / checkpoints tested
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 45 days

metrics.name: trademark_watch_alerts
metrics.plain: Open alerts on the brand's own marks, domains or handles
metrics.formula: count of open alerts (renewal due, lookalike registration)
metrics.unavailable_when: watch not yet set up

metrics.name: messaging_hierarchy_adoption
metrics.plain: Share of live page and channel types that lead with the current top message
metrics.formula: page or channel instances matching the current hierarchy top line / total scanned
metrics.source: messaging hierarchy x live copy scan
metrics.unavailable_when: no hierarchy set for that page type

metrics.name: perception_gap_score
metrics.plain: How closely customer language matches the positioning statement
metrics.formula: share of top review and mention terms that also appear in the positioning statement and voice sheet
metrics.source: reviews and mentions x positioning statement
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 30 reviews or mentions in the period

insights.name: avatar gone stale
insights.rule: avatar_freshness_days over 90 for the primary avatar
insights.sentence: The primary avatar has not been re-checked in {n} days. Confirm it still holds before the next brief.
insights.severity: high if this avatar backs live spend, else medium

insights.name: new objection not yet mapped
insights.rule: a phrase cluster appears in 5 or more reviews or tickets in a period and matches no entry in the objection map
insights.sentence: {n} customers raised '{phrase}' this month. It has no listed remover yet.

insights.name: voice drift on a live asset
insights.rule: an asset scanned this audit fails a voice rule it passed last audit
insights.sentence: {asset} now breaks the voice sheet on {rule}. It passed last time.
insights.severity: medium, high if on a paid landing page

insights.name: unverified claim about to ship
insights.rule: a claim tagged for a live page or ad has no passed evidence tier
insights.sentence: '{claim}' is scheduled to go live with no evidence on file.

insights.name: branded search falling at flat spend
insights.rule: branded_search_index drops more than 15 percent over 8 weeks while paid spend is flat or up
insights.sentence: Branded search fell {pct} percent over 8 weeks while spend held steady.

insights.name: sentiment turned amid a mention spike
insights.rule: mention_volume rises more than 2x the trailing average and mention_sentiment_net turns negative in the same week
insights.sentence: Mentions jumped {x}x this week and sentiment went negative. This may need a holding statement.

insights.name: repeat rate falling for the primary avatar
insights.rule: repeat_purchase_rate for the primary avatar's segment drops more than 5 points quarter over quarter
insights.sentence: Repeat purchase among {avatar} fell {pts} points this quarter.

insights.name: banked phrase never used
insights.rule: a phrase logged 10 or more times in the language bank appears in zero live assets
insights.sentence: Customers say '{phrase}' often, but it is in none of our live copy.

insights.name: trademark or handle risk
insights.rule: a renewal falls due within 60 days, or a new registration matches the brand name closely
insights.sentence: {item} needs attention: {reason}.

insights.name: mystery shopper found a broken step
insights.rule: a journey checkpoint fails on the latest run that passed on the prior run
insights.sentence: The {step} step of the buying journey failed on the latest check.

insights.name: AI persona pretest flagged a miss
insights.rule: a persona pretest scores a message or name below the pass threshold set for that test
insights.sentence: '{concept}' scored low with the {persona} persona before any real spend.

insights.name: perception gap widening
insights.rule: perception_gap_score drops more than 10 points quarter over quarter
insights.sentence: What customers say about us now matches our positioning statement {pct} percent less than last quarter.

visuals.name: avatar evidence board
visuals.type: card grid, one card per avatar
visuals.shows: job statement, 5W profile, quote count, freshness, provisional flag
visuals.why_this_chart: founder sees the whole avatar and its proof at a glance, not a wall of text

visuals.name: language bank frequency chart
visuals.shows: top phrases by mention count, tagged used or unused in live copy
visuals.why_this_chart: shows which real words are sitting unused

visuals.name: voice compliance heatmap
visuals.shows: pass or fail per audit for site, ads and email over time
visuals.why_this_chart: shows where and when drift happens, not just a single score

visuals.name: brand health trend lines
visuals.shows: branded search, mention volume, net sentiment and repeat rate over time
visuals.why_this_chart: the pattern from the Meta gallery's daily series charts, applied to brand health instead of ad spend

visuals.name: objection to remover table
visuals.shows: each named objection next to its proven remover and coverage flag

not_elsewhere.claim: the avatar record gates every field against a completeness checklist and marks itself provisional until a pattern shows across independent sources
not_elsewhere.vs: voice-of-customer tools like Mopinion or CustomerHero summarize themes but do not gate a single, traceable avatar record before it can be used

not_elsewhere.claim: the language bank tracks reuse rate of real customer phrases in live copy, not just a tone score on a draft
not_elsewhere.vs: brand voice checkers like ClickUp, Averi and Sprites score whether a document sounds on-brand, but do not trace phrases back to a customer quote or measure whether the brand's own banked words ever get used

not_elsewhere.claim: the consistency audit walks the live site, live ads and live email together on one cadence with one rule set
not_elsewhere.vs: voice tools check one document you paste in at a time, not the brand's whole live surface

not_elsewhere.claim: brand health here joins branded search, mentions, sentiment and repeat purchase from the brand's own store data into one line
not_elsewhere.vs: brand tracking suites such as Brand24, Talkwalker or Brandwatch price from about 200 to 800 dollars a month and do not tie mention and sentiment data to the brand's own repeat-purchase numbers

not_elsewhere.claim: the perception gap check compares the positioning statement word for word against the brand's own reviews and support tickets
not_elsewhere.vs: brand tracking tools survey a panel; this compares against what this brand's actual customers already said, for free

not_elsewhere.claim: the mystery shopper audit runs the brand's own live journey end to end, including a real support query, on demand and repeatably
not_elsewhere.vs: a paid human mystery-shopper audit is a one-off snapshot, not a repeatable automated check

not_elsewhere.claim: objection pairing here is the real thing that removed the objection for a real customer, tied to a support macro
not_elsewhere.vs: no off-the-shelf tool builds this pairing from the brand's own support and review evidence

data_needs.connector_or_script: search console or SEO tool, mention listening feed, store order history, BRAND-C48

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows every avatar as provisional, every metric as unavailable, and an empty language bank. It tells the founder the fastest way in is a review export and a support ticket export, since those alone unlock avatar mining, the language bank, objection pairing and the first brand health line. Once reviews and orders land, the room fills in avatar evidence, repeat rate and review rating first, since those need no separate connector.

metrics.name: competitors_tracked
metrics.plain: How many named competitor brands are on watch
metrics.formula: count of active entries in the competitor set
metrics.unavailable_when: never, defaults to 0
metrics.benchmark: 7, per the Gehna gallery pattern

metrics.name: price_position_index
metrics.plain: Where the brand's price sits versus the tracked competitors on a matched product
metrics.formula: brand price / median competitor price for the matched product, times 100
metrics.source: competitor price capture x brand price list
metrics.unavailable_when: no matched product across brands

metrics.name: price_change_count
metrics.plain: How many price moves the tracked competitors made
metrics.formula: count of price changes across all competitors
metrics.source: competitor price capture, week over week
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 captures exist to compare

metrics.name: new_creative_count
metrics.plain: New competitor ads detected
metrics.formula: count of ad creatives first seen this period, per competitor
metrics.unavailable_when: no capture this period

metrics.name: new_launch_count
metrics.plain: New products, collections or channels a competitor entered
metrics.formula: count of new SKUs, collections or marketplace listings detected
metrics.unavailable_when: no capture this period

metrics.name: positioning_openness_score
metrics.plain: How much of the positioning map is unclaimed
metrics.formula: open quadrants / total quadrants on the map
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 3 competitors plotted

metrics.name: category_ladder_coverage
metrics.plain: How many real alternatives, including doing nothing, are mapped
metrics.formula: count of distinct rungs logged on the ladder
metrics.unavailable_when: ladder has fewer than 2 rungs

metrics.name: market_size_estimate
metrics.plain: How many repeat buyers at this brand's own AOV and margin would sustain the business
metrics.formula: target profit / (AOV times margin times repeat orders per buyer per year)
metrics.source: brand's own order and margin data
metrics.unavailable_when: no margin data on file

metrics.name: addressable_niche_size
metrics.plain: Estimated demand for a candidate niche
metrics.formula: search or category demand signal for the niche, scaled by the brand's realistic capture rate
metrics.source: public demand signal x brand's own conversion history
metrics.unavailable_when: no public demand signal available for that niche

metrics.name: win_rate_vs_named_competitor
metrics.plain: Share of studied almost-buyers who chose the brand over one named competitor
metrics.formula: wins / (wins plus losses) in the win-loss sample
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 10 respondents in the round

metrics.name: battlecard_freshness_days
metrics.plain: Days since a battlecard claim was last verified
metrics.formula: today minus last verification date, per claim
metrics.unavailable_when: battlecard has no verification date
metrics.benchmark: flag over 90 days

metrics.name: competitor_activity_share
metrics.plain: Share of tracked competitor ad activity by count, as a public signal only
metrics.formula: this competitor's new creatives / total new creatives across all tracked competitors
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 5 total creatives detected in the period

metrics.name: premium_signal_score
metrics.plain: How many premium signals the brand shows versus the category norm
metrics.formula: count of premium signals present (packaging, guarantee, service, price anchor) / count expected for the category
metrics.unavailable_when: no audit run yet

metrics.name: discount_depth_vs_category
metrics.plain: How deep the brand discounts versus tracked competitors
metrics.formula: brand's average discount percent minus competitor median discount percent
metrics.source: price capture, sale versus list price
metrics.unavailable_when: no sale price data captured

metrics.name: positioning_test_score
metrics.plain: Which of 2 positioning frames won when tested against each other
metrics.formula: share preferring frame A minus share preferring frame B, in the test sample
metrics.unavailable_when: no test has run

insights.name: competitor cut price sharply
insights.rule: a tracked competitor's price on a matched product drops more than 15 percent versus its own trailing 30-day average
insights.sentence: {competitor} cut the price on {product} by {pct} percent.
insights.severity: high if it is a top matched product, else medium

insights.name: competitor tried a new angle
insights.rule: a tracked competitor's new creative uses a hook or product tag not seen from them in the trailing 90 days
insights.sentence: {competitor} is now running a new angle: {angle}.

insights.name: competitor entered a new channel
insights.rule: a tracked competitor's product is newly listed on a marketplace or channel it was not on last capture
insights.sentence: {competitor} is now selling on {channel}.

insights.name: open quadrant with real demand
insights.rule: a positioning map quadrant has zero competitors plotted and a non-zero demand signal
insights.sentence: No tracked brand is claiming '{quadrant}', and there is real search demand for it.

insights.name: price has drifted outside the category range
insights.rule: price_position_index falls outside the learned range (a set band around the category median) for 2 consecutive captures
insights.sentence: The brand's price is now {pct} percent {above_below} the category range.

insights.name: discounting is undercutting premium positioning
insights.rule: discount_depth_vs_category is positive and premium_signal_score is above the category norm at the same time
insights.sentence: The brand discounts {pct} points deeper than the category while claiming a premium position.

insights.name: the same loss reason keeps repeating
insights.rule: the same coded reason appears in 3 or more win-loss interviews against the same named competitor
insights.sentence: {n} people chose {competitor} over us for the same reason: {reason}.

insights.name: battlecard claim is stale
insights.rule: battlecard_freshness_days exceeds 90 for a claim still in active use
insights.sentence: The claim '{claim}' on the {competitor} battlecard has not been checked in {n} days.

insights.name: a lower rung of the ladder is gaining
insights.rule: public demand signal for a lower-commitment alternative (including doing nothing) rises faster than demand for the category itself
insights.sentence: Interest in '{rung}' is growing faster than interest in the category.

visuals.name: XY positioning map
visuals.shows: brand and every tracked competitor plotted, with open quadrants marked
visuals.why_this_chart: the founder sees open space, not a list of adjectives

visuals.name: price ladder
visuals.shows: brand and the 7 competitors' prices on a matched product, with the category range shaded

visuals.name: competitor change feed
visuals.shows: new creative, price move or launch per competitor, most recent first

visuals.name: category ladder diagram
visuals.shows: every rung from doing nothing up to the closest direct rival, with the brand's position marked
visuals.why_this_chart: keeps the brand honest about who it is really up against

visuals.name: battlecard table
visuals.shows: brand versus one named competitor, verified differences only, with a freshness flag
visuals.why_this_chart: support can read it in one glance mid-conversation

visuals.name: win-loss reason breakdown

actions.label: Pull a fresh competitor research pass

not_elsewhere.claim: battlecards here are gated on verified differences with a refresh cadence and a staleness flag

founder_view_note: With no competitor capture connected, the room shows the 7 brands already in the Gehna gallery with sites and ad libraries listed but every price, positioning and freshness metric marked unavailable. metrics.name: active_bets_by_stage
metrics.plain: How many wild bets sit in each stage of the pipeline
metrics.formula: count of bets grouped by stage (idea, bounded, executing, at read point, scaled, killed)
metrics.unavailable_when: pipeline is empty

metrics.name: bet_bound_completeness
metrics.plain: How many of the 8 required bound fields are filled for a bet before launch
metrics.formula: filled fields / 8
metrics.unavailable_when: bet has not reached bounding stage
metrics.benchmark: must be 8 of 8 before it can move to executing

metrics.name: bet_read_point_lift
metrics.plain: How much better or worse the bet did than its control
metrics.formula: treated group metric minus control group metric, on the bet's named metric
metrics.window: at the bet's own read point date
metrics.unavailable_when: bet has not reached its read point, or has no control

metrics.name: bet_cycle_time_days
metrics.plain: Days a bet has spent in its current stage
metrics.formula: today minus stage entry date
metrics.unavailable_when: never, always computable once a bet exists
metrics.benchmark: flag if past the bet's own planned read point date

metrics.name: pr_coverage_count
metrics.plain: Press placements landed
metrics.formula: count of confirmed placements per period
metrics.unavailable_when: no monitoring connected

metrics.name: media_list_coverage
metrics.plain: Verified contacts matched to the current story
metrics.formula: count of contacts with a confirmed beat match for this pitch
metrics.unavailable_when: no media list built for this story yet

metrics.name: partnership_pipeline_count
metrics.plain: Partnership candidates at each stage
metrics.formula: count grouped by stage (sourced, screened, reputation-checked, approved)
metrics.unavailable_when: pipeline is empty

metrics.name: partnership_reputation_flags
metrics.plain: Open reputation risk flags on a proposed partner
metrics.formula: count of unresolved flags per candidate
metrics.unavailable_when: no check has run for that candidate

metrics.name: ambassador_active_count
metrics.plain: Ambassadors currently active in the program
metrics.formula: count of ambassadors with status active
metrics.unavailable_when: no program set up

metrics.name: ambassador_content_approval_rate
metrics.plain: Share of submitted ambassador content that passed the guidelines check
metrics.formula: approved submissions / total submissions
metrics.unavailable_when: no submissions in the window

metrics.name: referral_order_share
metrics.plain: Share of orders that came through a referral
metrics.formula: orders with a referral code or link / total orders
metrics.source: store order data with referral attribution
metrics.unavailable_when: no referral tracking set up

metrics.name: event_attendance
metrics.plain: People who showed up at the last event or pop-up
metrics.formula: count of confirmed attendees
metrics.unavailable_when: no event has run

metrics.name: award_submission_status
metrics.plain: Awards and best-of lists tracked, submitted or won
metrics.formula: count grouped by status (eligible, submitted, won)
metrics.unavailable_when: no awards tracked yet

metrics.name: reputation_alert_count
metrics.plain: Open reputation risk alerts needing a response
metrics.formula: count of unresolved alerts from the mention spike rule
metrics.unavailable_when: no listening connector attached

metrics.name: festive_calendar_readiness
metrics.plain: Upcoming moments in the next 60 days with a brief already prepared
metrics.formula: moments with a brief / total moments in the next 60 days
metrics.unavailable_when: calendar has no entries in that window

insights.name: bet is overdue at its stage
insights.rule: bet_cycle_time_days exceeds the bet's own planned duration for its current stage
insights.sentence: {bet} has sat in {stage} for {n} days, past its own plan.

insights.name: bet shows no lift at its read point
insights.rule: bet_read_point_lift is at or below zero against control at the bet's own read point date
insights.sentence: {bet} showed no real lift over the control group at its read point.

insights.name: bet shows a real lift
insights.rule: bet_read_point_lift is positive and above the bet's own pre-set bar at its read point
insights.sentence: {bet} beat its control by {n}. Worth sizing up.

insights.name: reputation risk building
insights.rule: mention or review volume in the reputation monitor rises more than 2x the trailing average with a negative tilt
insights.sentence: Mentions of the brand jumped {x}x this week with a negative tilt. A holding statement is drafted and waiting.

insights.name: media list going stale
insights.rule: a contact on the current media list has not been reachable or has changed beat since the list was built
insights.sentence: {n} contacts on the {story} list need a re-check before this pitch goes out.

insights.name: festive moment coming up with no brief
insights.rule: a calendar moment falls within 30 days and has no linked brief
insights.sentence: {moment} is {n} days away with no brief started.

insights.name: partnership candidate flagged
insights.rule: a reputation check on a partnership candidate returns an open flag
insights.sentence: {candidate} has an open reputation flag: {reason}.

insights.name: ambassador content waiting too long
insights.rule: a submission has sat unreviewed longer than the program's own review SLA
insights.sentence: {n} ambassador submissions have waited past the review deadline.

insights.name: award deadline approaching, nothing started
insights.rule: an eligible award's submission deadline falls within 21 days and status is still 'eligible'
insights.sentence: The {award} deadline is {n} days away and nothing is submitted yet.

visuals.name: bet pipeline board
visuals.shows: every wild bet from idea to bounded to executing to read point to scaled or killed
visuals.why_this_chart: the speed lab pattern of a staged chain, applied to bets instead of site fixes

visuals.name: read point comparison chart
visuals.shows: treatment versus control on the bet's own named metric
visuals.why_this_chart: shows the actual test result, not a feeling about how it went

visuals.name: PR coverage timeline
visuals.shows: placements landed, outlet, and reach where available
visuals.why_this_chart: the founder sees momentum, not a spreadsheet of clippings

visuals.name: festive and cultural calendar
visuals.shows: upcoming dates with brief-ready status color coded
visuals.why_this_chart: flags gaps before a date is missed, not after

visuals.name: partnership funnel
visuals.shows: candidates sourced, screened, reputation-checked, approved
visuals.why_this_chart: shows where candidates are dropping out and why

visuals.name: reputation risk monitor
visuals.shows: mention or review volume over time with spikes marked
visuals.why_this_chart: the founder sees a brewing problem before it is a crisis

not_elsewhere.claim: the bet pipeline enforces an 8-field bound (budget cap, downside limit, control design, cohort, stop rule, read point, legal review, and the bound itself) before a bet can launch, and reads it against a real control in code
not_elsewhere.vs: no off-the-shelf PR or project management tool gates a marketing bet against a written downside limit and a measured control group

not_elsewhere.claim: the reputation monitor ties a mention or review spike directly to a drafted holding statement in the same room
not_elsewhere.vs: Muck Rack and Prowly monitor coverage and mentions but do not draft a holding statement tied to this brand's own crisis playbook

not_elsewhere.claim: partnership sourcing and reputation screening run in one pipeline, checked against the brand's own non-competitive, same-customer rule
not_elsewhere.vs: generic partnership or CRM tools track deals but do not screen for category overlap or run a reputation check as one gated step

not_elsewhere.claim: the media list is built and verified per specific story or launch, matched to real beats
not_elsewhere.vs: Muck Rack and Prowly sell a static, purchased journalist database; this room builds a small verified list for the story at hand

not_elsewhere.claim: the festive and cultural calendar is scoped to this brand's own category, PR needs, events and community moments, not a generic marketing holiday calendar
not_elsewhere.vs: generic marketing calendars list every holiday, not the ones that matter for this brand's category and PR angles

not_elsewhere.claim: the ambassador program room runs screening, task assignment, content approval and tracking end to end for this brand's own program
not_elsewhere.vs: generic UGC rights tools manage content rights but do not run the day-to-day of an approved ambassador program

data_needs.connector_or_script: mention listening feed, BRAND-C54 (shared with brand health)

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the bet pipeline board starts empty except for whatever ideas are logged by hand, the PR timeline and media list show no entries, and the reputation monitor stays unavailable until a mention feed is attached. The first useful state comes from logging even one bet with its 8-field bound, since that alone lights up the pipeline board, the bound-completeness metric and the read-point chart once the read date arrives.
